### RVENet（RVENet-MedSAM2）数据集是什么？
`RVENet-MedSAM2` 是 MedSAM2 释出的一个**带像素级标注的医疗视频/序列分割数据集**（每个 case 是一段序列，每帧都有对应 mask），README 里把它作为可下载的标注数据之一列出，并提示引用原始 RVENET 数据集论文/页面（`rvenet.github.io`）[[MedSAM2 README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bowang-lab/MedSAM2/main/README.md)]、[[RVENet-MedSAM2(HF)](https://huggingface.co/datasets/wanglab/RVENet-MedSAM2)]、[[RVENET dataset page](https://rvenet.github.io/dataset/)]。

### 你现在卡住的原因（核心）
你解压出来的只有 `Annotations-MedSAM2/.../*.png`（掩码帧）。但无论是 **视频推理脚本**还是 **训练用的 PNGRawDataset**，都还需要对应的**图像帧目录**，并且默认只读取 `*.jpg / *.jpeg` 帧。

### 1）让 MedSAM2“用 RVENet 做视频分割推理”（不训练）
把数据整理成下面这种**两棵目录同名对齐**的结构（`video_name` 必须一致；帧名要能对上：例如帧是 `0000.jpg`，mask 就是 `0000.png`）：

- `base_video_dir/<video_name>/*.jpg`
- `input_mask_dir/<video_name>/*.png`（你现在的 `Annotations-MedSAM2` 就是它）

然后直接跑（路径务必用绝对路径）：

```bash
python /root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/medsam2_infer_video.py \
  --sam2_checkpoint /root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/checkpoints/MedSAM2_latest.pt \
  -i /root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/RVENet-MedSAM2/Frames-MedSAM2 \
  -m /root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/RVENet-MedSAM2/Annotations-MedSAM2 \
  -o /root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/RVENet-MedSAM2/pred_masks
```

- 如果你的输入掩码不止第一帧、想全用：加 `--use_all_masks`
- 如果有些目标不是第一帧出现：加 `--track_object_appearing_later_in_video`

### 2）让 MedSAM2“用 RVENet 做训练”（需要加一个数据集配置）
训练配置里 `data -> train -> datasets` 原本示例用的是 `NPZRawDataset(RECIST_train_npz)`；RVENet 这种“帧+png mask”应改用 `PNGRawDataset`（代码已内置），关键是补齐 `img_folder`（帧 jpg）和 `gt_folder`（你的 `Annotations-MedSAM2`）[[MedSAM2 README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bowang-lab/MedSAM2/main/README.md)]。

你可以新建一个 yaml（建议从 `sam2/configs/sam2.1_hiera_tiny_finetune512.yaml` 复制一份）并把 `datasets` 这段替换成类似这样（只示意关键段）：

```yaml
data:
  train:
    datasets:
      - _target_: training.dataset.vos_dataset.VOSDataset
        transforms: ${vos.train_transforms}
        training: true
        video_dataset:
          _target_: training.dataset.vos_raw_dataset.PNGRawDataset
          img_folder: /root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/RVENet-MedSAM2/Frames-MedSAM2
          gt_folder: /root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/RVENet-MedSAM2/Annotations-MedSAM2
          sample_rate: 1
          is_palette: true
        sampler:
          _target_: training.dataset.vos_sampler.RandomUniformSampler
          num_frames: ${scratch.num_frames}
          max_num_objects: ${scratch.max_num_objects}
        multiplier: 1
```

然后用你这个新 config 跑训练入口（或改 `single_node_train_medsam2.sh` 指向新 config）。

### 你接下来需要确认/补齐的一件事
你的 `RVENet-MedSAM2` 目录目前只有 `Annotations-MedSAM2`，所以还需要从数据集包里拿到对应的**帧图像目录**（常见叫 `Frames-*`/`Images-*`）。另外如果帧是 `*.png` 而不是 `*.jpg`，脚本/loader 默认不会读——要么把帧转成 jpg，要么改代码把 `*.jpg` 扩展到 `*.png`（你如果希望我直接给你改哪几行，切到 Agent mode 我可以帮你改）。

## 对照实验 A：用 MedSAM2 跑（建议做“NPZ 对照”）
MedSAM2 官方训练示例是让你在配置里填 `data -> train -> datasets`，示例数据是 **NPZRawDataset**（npz 内含 `imgs`/`gts`）[[MedSAM2](https://github.com/bowang-lab/MedSAM2/)]、[[MedSAM2 README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bowang-lab/MedSAM2/main/README.md)]。

### A1）把 LLD-MMRI（nii.gz）转换成 MedSAM2 需要的 `.npz`
建议生成结构：
```
/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/LLD-MMRI/npz_train/
  <case_id>.npz   # keys: imgs, gts
```

转换脚本（先给你可复制的版本；真正落地改进/并行加速等你切 Agent mode 再做）：

```python
import os, glob
import numpy as np
import SimpleITK as sitk

src_img = "/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/LLD-MMRI/LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2/images"
src_lab = "/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/LLD-MMRI/LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2/labels"
out_dir = "/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/LLD-MMRI/npz_train"
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

for img_path in glob.glob(os.path.join(src_img, "*.nii.gz")):
    base = os.path.basename(img_path)
    if not base.endswith("_0000.nii.gz"):
        continue
    case_id = base[:-len("_0000.nii.gz")]  # 去掉 _0000.nii.gz
    lab_path = os.path.join(src_lab, case_id + ".nii.gz")
    if not os.path.exists(lab_path):
        continue

    img = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(sitk.ReadImage(img_path))  # (D,H,W)
    lab = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(sitk.ReadImage(lab_path))  # (D,H,W)

    # 这里先假设是二分类/或把>0当作前景
    lab = (lab > 0).astype(np.uint8)

    # MedSAM2 的 NPZRawDataset 会做 imgs/255 并扩成3通道；所以这里把 imgs 压到 [0,255]
    img = img.astype(np.float32)
    img = img - img.min()
    img = img / (img.max() + 1e-8)
    img = (img * 255.0).astype(np.uint8)

    np.savez_compressed(os.path.join(out_dir, case_id + ".npz"), imgs=img, gts=lab)
```

### A2）用 MedSAM2 训练配置跑一个“对照微调”
你需要复制一份配置（例如从 `sam2/configs/sam2.1_hiera_tiny_finetune512.yaml` 或 `...FLARE_RECIST.yaml` 改），把 `NPZRawDataset.folder` 指到你生成的 `npz_train`，然后运行训练入口：

- 训练入口在 MedSAM2 是 `python training/train.py -c <config.yaml>`（仓库自带 `single_node_train_medsam2.sh` 就是这么调用的）[[MedSAM2 README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bowang-lab/MedSAM2/main/README.md)]。

    "codeblockId": "b0511792-d640-458c-aad4-9e654aa4303f",
    "codeBlockIdx": 0,
    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nCreate deterministic splits for LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2.\n\nAssumptions (matches your dataset):\n- images:   images/&lt;case_id&gt;_0000.nii.gz\n- labels:   labels/&lt;case_id&gt;.nii.gz\n\nOutputs (text files, one case_id per line):\n- train.txt, val.txt\n- labeled.txt, unlabeled.txt  (labeled/unlabeled are a partition of train)\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport glob\nimport os\nimport random\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\n\ndef strip_nii_suffix(name: str) -&gt; str:\n    if name.endswith(\".nii.gz\"):\n        return name[: -len(\".nii.gz\")]\n    if name.endswith(\".nii\"):\n        return name[: -len(\".nii\")]\n    return os.path.splitext(name)[0]\n\n\ndef discover_case_ids(data_root: str) -&gt; list[str]:\n    img_dir = os.path.join(data_root, \"images\")\n    lab_dir = os.path.join(data_root, \"labels\")\n    img_paths = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(img_dir, \"*.nii*\")))\n    lab_names = set(strip_nii_suffix(os.path.basename(p)) for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(lab_dir, \"*.nii*\")))\n\n    case_ids: list[str] = []\n    missing: list[str] = []\n    for p in img_paths:\n        b = os.path.basename(p)\n        if not (b.endswith(\"_0000.nii.gz\") or b.endswith(\"_0000.nii\")):\n            continue\n        case = strip_nii_suffix(b)\n        if case.endswith(\"_0000\"):\n            case = case[: -len(\"_0000\")]\n        if case in lab_names:\n            case_ids.append(case)\n        else:\n            missing.append(case)\n\n    if missing:\n        raise RuntimeError(\n            f\"Found {len(missing)} images without labels under {data_root}. \"\n            f\"Example missing: {missing[:5]}\"\n        )\n    if not case_ids:\n        raise RuntimeError(f\"No paired cases found under {data_root}. Check folder structure.\")\n    return sorted(case_ids)\n\n\ndef write_list(path: str, items: list[str]) -&gt; None:\n    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)\n    with open(path, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        for x in items:\n            f.write(x + \"\\n\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Splits:\n    train: list[str]\n    val: list[str]\n    labeled: list[str]\n    unlabeled: list[str]\n\n\ndef make_splits(\n    case_ids: list[str],\n    seed: int,\n    val_frac: float,\n    labeled_frac: float,\n) -&gt; Splits:\n    if not (0.0 &lt; val_frac &lt; 1.0):\n        raise ValueError(\"val_frac must be in (0,1)\")\n    if not (0.0 &lt; labeled_frac &lt; 1.0):\n        raise ValueError(\"labeled_frac must be in (0,1)\")\n\n    rng = random.Random(seed)\n    ids = case_ids[:]\n    rng.shuffle(ids)\n\n    n_val = max(1, int(round(len(ids) * val_frac)))\n    val = sorted(ids[:n_val])\n    train = sorted(ids[n_val:])\n\n    n_labeled = max(1, int(round(len(train) * labeled_frac)))\n    train_shuffled = train[:]\n    rng.shuffle(train_shuffled)\n    labeled = sorted(train_shuffled[:n_labeled])\n    unlabeled = sorted(train_shuffled[n_labeled:])\n\n    return Splits(train=train, val=val, labeled=labeled, unlabeled=unlabeled)\n\n\ndef main() -&gt; None:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--data_root\",\n        type=str,\n        default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/LLD-MMRI/LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2\",\n        help=\"Root folder containing images/ and labels/\",\n    )\n    ap.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=42)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--val_frac\", type=float, default=0.2)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--labeled_frac\", type=float, default=0.3)\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--out_dir\",\n        type=str,\n        default=None,\n        help=\"Output directory for split files. Default: &lt;data_root&gt;/splits/seed{seed}_val{val_frac}_lab{labeled_frac}\",\n    )\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    case_ids = discover_case_ids(args.data_root)\n    splits = make_splits(case_ids, seed=args.seed, val_frac=args.val_frac, labeled_frac=args.labeled_frac)\n\n    out_dir = args.out_dir or os.path.join(\n        args.data_root,\n        \"splits\",\n        f\"seed{args.seed}_val{args.val_frac:g}_lab{args.labeled_frac:g}\",\n    )\n\n    write_list(os.path.join(out_dir, \"all.txt\"), sorted(case_ids))\n    write_list(os.path.join(out_dir, \"train.txt\"), splits.train)\n    write_list(os.path.join(out_dir, \"val.txt\"), splits.val)\n    write_list(os.path.join(out_dir, \"labeled.txt\"), splits.labeled)\n    write_list(os.path.join(out_dir, \"unlabeled.txt\"), splits.unlabeled)\n\n    print(\"LLD-MMRI splits written to:\", out_dir)\n    print(\"counts:\",\n          f\"all={len(case_ids)}\",\n          f\"train={len(splits.train)}\",\n          f\"val={len(splits.val)}\",\n          f\"labeled={len(splits.labeled)}\",\n          f\"unlabeled={len(splits.unlabeled)}\",\n          )\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n\n",
    "languageId": "python"
  }
}

  "contentsAfterEdit": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nCreate deterministic splits for LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2.\n\nAssumptions (matches your dataset):\n- images:   images/&lt;case_id&gt;_0000.nii.gz\n- labels:   labels/&lt;case_id&gt;.nii.gz\n\nOutputs (text files, one case_id per line):\n- train.txt, val.txt\n- labeled.txt, unlabeled.txt  (labeled/unlabeled are a partition of train)\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport glob\nimport os\nimport random\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\n\ndef strip_nii_suffix(name: str) -&gt; str:\n    if name.endswith(\".nii.gz\"):\n        return name[: -len(\".nii.gz\")]\n    if name.endswith(\".nii\"):\n        return name[: -len(\".nii\")]\n    return os.path.splitext(name)[0]\n\n\ndef discover_case_ids(data_root: str) -&gt; list[str]:\n    img_dir = os.path.join(data_root, \"images\")\n    lab_dir = os.path.join(data_root, \"labels\")\n    img_paths = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(img_dir, \"*.nii*\")))\n    lab_names = set(strip_nii_suffix(os.path.basename(p)) for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(lab_dir, \"*.nii*\")))\n\n    case_ids: list[str] = []\n    missing: list[str] = []\n    for p in img_paths:\n        b = os.path.basename(p)\n        if not (b.endswith(\"_0000.nii.gz\") or b.endswith(\"_0000.nii\")):\n            continue\n        case = strip_nii_suffix(b)\n        if case.endswith(\"_0000\"):\n            case = case[: -len(\"_0000\")]\n        if case in lab_names:\n            case_ids.append(case)\n        else:\n            missing.append(case)\n\n    if missing:\n        raise RuntimeError(\n            f\"Found {len(missing)} images without labels under {data_root}. \"\n            f\"Example missing: {missing[:5]}\"\n        )\n    if not case_ids:\n        raise RuntimeError(f\"No paired cases found under {data_root}. Check folder structure.\")\n    return sorted(case_ids)\n\n\ndef write_list(path: str, items: list[str]) -&gt; None:\n    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)\n    with open(path, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        for x in items:\n            f.write(x + \"\\n\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Splits:\n    train: list[str]\n    val: list[str]\n    labeled: list[str]\n    unlabeled: list[str]\n\n\ndef make_splits(\n    case_ids: list[str],\n    seed: int,\n    val_frac: float,\n    labeled_frac: float,\n) -&gt; Splits:\n    if not (0.0 &lt; val_frac &lt; 1.0):\n        raise ValueError(\"val_frac must be in (0,1)\")\n    if not (0.0 &lt; labeled_frac &lt; 1.0):\n        raise ValueError(\"labeled_frac must be in (0,1)\")\n\n    rng = random.Random(seed)\n    ids = case_ids[:]\n    rng.shuffle(ids)\n\n    n_val = max(1, int(round(len(ids) * val_frac)))\n    val = sorted(ids[:n_val])\n    train = sorted(ids[n_val:])\n\n    n_labeled = max(1, int(round(len(train) * labeled_frac)))\n    train_shuffled = train[:]\n    rng.shuffle(train_shuffled)\n    labeled = sorted(train_shuffled[:n_labeled])\n    unlabeled = sorted(train_shuffled[n_labeled:])\n\n    return Splits(train=train, val=val, labeled=labeled, unlabeled=unlabeled)\n\n\ndef main() -&gt; None:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--data_root\",\n        type=str,\n        default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/LLD-MMRI/LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2\",\n        help=\"Root folder containing images/ and labels/\",\n    )\n    ap.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=42)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--val_frac\", type=float, default=0.2)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--labeled_frac\", type=float, default=0.3)\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--out_dir\",\n        type=str,\n        default=None,\n        help=\"Output directory for split files. Default: &lt;data_root&gt;/splits/seed{seed}_val{val_frac}_lab{labeled_frac}\",\n    )\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    case_ids = discover_case_ids(args.data_root)\n    splits = make_splits(case_ids, seed=args.seed, val_frac=args.val_frac, labeled_frac=args.labeled_frac)\n\n    out_dir = args.out_dir or os.path.join(\n        args.data_root,\n        \"splits\",\n        f\"seed{args.seed}_val{args.val_frac:g}_lab{args.labeled_frac:g}\",\n    )\n\n    write_list(os.path.join(out_dir, \"all.txt\"), sorted(case_ids))\n    write_list(os.path.join(out_dir, \"train.txt\"), splits.train)\n    write_list(os.path.join(out_dir, \"val.txt\"), splits.val)\n    write_list(os.path.join(out_dir, \"labeled.txt\"), splits.labeled)\n    write_list(os.path.join(out_dir, \"unlabeled.txt\"), splits.unlabeled)\n\n    print(\"LLD-MMRI splits written to:\", out_dir)\n    print(\"counts:\",\n          f\"all={len(case_ids)}\",\n          f\"train={len(splits.train)}\",\n          f\"val={len(splits.val)}\",\n          f\"labeled={len(splits.labeled)}\",\n          f\"unlabeled={len(splits.unlabeled)}\",\n          )\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n\n"
}

    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nConvert LLD-MMRI NIfTI volumes to MedSAM2 NPZ format for training/inference.\n\nWrites one &lt;case_id&gt;.npz per case with keys:\n- imgs: uint8 array (D,H,W) in [0,255]\n- gts:  uint8 array (D,H,W) in {0,1}\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport os\nfrom typing import Iterable\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport SimpleITK as sitk\n\n\ndef read_list(path: str) -&gt; list[str]:\n    with open(path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        return [ln.strip() for ln in f.readlines() if ln.strip()]\n\n\ndef normalize_to_uint8(x: np.ndarray) -&gt; np.ndarray:\n    if x.dtype == np.uint8 and x.min() &gt;= 0 and x.max() &lt;= 255:\n        return x\n    x = x.astype(np.float32)\n    x = x - float(x.min())\n    denom = float(x.max()) + 1e-8\n    x = x / denom\n    x = (x * 255.0).round().clip(0, 255).astype(np.uint8)\n    return x\n\n\ndef convert_cases(\n    case_ids: Iterable[str],\n    data_root: str,\n    out_dir: str,\n) -&gt; None:\n    img_dir = os.path.join(data_root, \"images\")\n    lab_dir = os.path.join(data_root, \"labels\")\n    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)\n\n    n_ok = 0\n    for i, case_id in enumerate(case_ids, start=1):\n        img_path = os.path.join(img_dir, f\"{case_id}_0000.nii.gz\")\n        if not os.path.exists(img_path):\n            img_path = os.path.join(img_dir, f\"{case_id}_0000.nii\")\n        lab_path = os.path.join(lab_dir, f\"{case_id}.nii.gz\")\n        if not os.path.exists(lab_path):\n            lab_path = os.path.join(lab_dir, f\"{case_id}.nii\")\n\n        if not os.path.exists(img_path):\n            raise FileNotFoundError(f\"Missing image for {case_id}: {img_path}\")\n        if not os.path.exists(lab_path):\n            raise FileNotFoundError(f\"Missing label for {case_id}: {lab_path}\")\n\n        img = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(sitk.ReadImage(img_path))  # (D,H,W)\n        lab = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(sitk.ReadImage(lab_path))  # (D,H,W)\n        if img.shape != lab.shape:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Shape mismatch for {case_id}: img={img.shape}, lab={lab.shape}\")\n\n        imgs_u8 = normalize_to_uint8(img)\n        gts_u8 = (lab &gt; 0).astype(np.uint8)\n\n        out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, f\"{case_id}.npz\")\n        np.savez_compressed(out_path, imgs=imgs_u8, gts=gts_u8)\n        n_ok += 1\n        if i % 100 == 0:\n            print(f\"[{i}] converted {n_ok} cases -&gt; {out_dir}\")\n\n    print(f\"Done. Converted {n_ok} cases -&gt; {out_dir}\")\n\n\ndef main() -&gt; None:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--data_root\",\n        type=str,\n        default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/LLD-MMRI/LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2\",\n        help=\"Root folder containing images/ and labels/\",\n    )\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--case_list\",\n        type=str,\n        required=True,\n        help=\"Text file with one case_id per line (e.g. splits/.../labeled.txt)\",\n    )\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--out_dir\",\n        type=str,\n        required=True,\n        help=\"Output directory to write &lt;case_id&gt;.npz\",\n    )\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    case_ids = read_list(args.case_list)\n    convert_cases(case_ids, data_root=args.data_root, out_dir=args.out_dir)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n\n",

    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nPrepare nnUNetv2 raw dataset folders from LLD-MMRI NIfTI volumes.\n\nWe create a clean nnUNet ID scheme (case_000001, ...) because original IDs contain '+' and '-'.\n\nOutputs:\n&lt;nnunet_raw&gt;/Dataset&lt;id&gt;_LLDMMRI/\n  imagesTr/  case_000001_0000.nii.gz ...\n  labelsTr/  case_000001.nii.gz ...\n  imagesTs/  case_000101_0000.nii.gz ...   (optional)\n  dataset.json\n  case_mapping.csv  (nnunet_id, original_case_id, split)\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport csv\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\ndef read_list(path: str) -&gt; list[str]:\n    with open(path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        return [ln.strip() for ln in f.readlines() if ln.strip()]\n\n\ndef ensure_link_or_copy(src: str, dst: str, copy: bool) -&gt; None:\n    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)\n    if os.path.exists(dst):\n        return\n    if copy:\n        import shutil\n\n        shutil.copy2(src, dst)\n        return\n    os.symlink(src, dst)\n\n\ndef main() -&gt; None:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--dataset_id\", type=int, default=701, help=\"nnUNet dataset numeric id\")\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--data_root\",\n        type=str,\n        default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/LLD-MMRI/LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2\",\n        help=\"Root folder containing images/ and labels/\",\n    )\n    ap.add_argument(\"--train_list\", type=str, required=True, help=\"train.txt (case_id per line)\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--val_list\", type=str, required=True, help=\"val.txt (case_id per line)\")\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--nnunet_raw\",\n        type=str,\n        default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/nnUNet_raw\",\n        help=\"nnUNet_raw directory\",\n    )\n    ap.add_argument(\"--copy\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Copy files instead of symlinks\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    train_ids = read_list(args.train_list)\n    val_ids = read_list(args.val_list)\n\n    ds_name = f\"Dataset{args.dataset_id:03d}_LLDMMRI\"\n    ds_root = Path(args.nnunet_raw) / ds_name\n    imagesTr = ds_root / \"imagesTr\"\n    labelsTr = ds_root / \"labelsTr\"\n    imagesTs = ds_root / \"imagesTs\"\n    ds_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    imagesTr.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    labelsTr.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    imagesTs.mkdir(parents=True, mapping_path.open(\"w\", newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        w = csv.writer(f)\n        w.writerow([\"nnunet_id\", \"original_case_id\", \"split\"])\n\n        def _emit(case_ids:     "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nGenerate pseudo-labels for LLD-MMRI using SSL-MedSAM2's pseudo-logit ensembling.\n\nThis is an *adaptation wrapper* (LLD-MMRI specific) that reuses the original\nSSL-MedSAM2 code (dataloader_3d.py, random_mix_method.py, util_3d.py) without\nediting it, by importing it via sys.path.\n\nHigh-level:\n- Load labeled volumes (with GT masks) and unlabeled volumes (images only).\n- For each unlabeled volume, sample K labeled references.\n- For each labeled reference, run N random insert operations (whole_insert_a_to_b)\n  to produce multiple probability volumes (*.nii).\n- Ensemble those probability volumes into a single pseudo mask via util_3d.generate_uncert_and_pred,\n  saved as &lt;pred_dir&gt;/&lt;case_id&gt;.nii.gz (binary labels 0/1) + uncertainty map.\n\nNOTE:\n- This script can be very slow (SAM2 inference per volume). Use --max_unlabeled\n  and --part/--total_parts to parallelize across jobs.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport os\nimport random\nimport shutil\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport SimpleITK as sitk\nimport torch\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\n\nfrom sam2.build_sam import build_sam2_video_predictor_npz\n\n\ndef read_list(path: str) -&gt; list[str]:\n    with open(path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        return [ln.strip() for ln in f.readlines() if ln.strip()]\n\n\ndef main() -&gt; None:\n    ap = ap.add_argument(\"--unlabeled_list\", type=str, required=True, help=\"unlabeled.txt (case_id per line)\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--ssl_code_dir\", type=str, default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/SSL-MedSAM2\", help=\"Path to SSL-MedSAM2 repo\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--sam2_cfg\", type=str, default=\"configs/sam2.1_hiera_t512.yaml\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--sam2_checkpoint\", type=str, default=\"checkpoints/MedSAM2_latest.pt\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--img_size\", type=int, default=512)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--z_axis\", type=int, ap.add_argument(\"--max_unlabeled\", type=int, default=-1, help=\"Limit # unlabeled cases (after part split); -1 for all\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--work_dir\", type=str, default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/exp_log/LLDMMRI_SSL\", help=\"Working/output root\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--only_largest_comp\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Keep only largest connected component in pseudo mask\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    # Import SSL-MedSAM2 modules without copying into MedSAM2\n    sys.path.insert(0, args.ssl_code_dir)\n    from dataloader_3d import MedicalVolumeDataset  # type: ignore\n    import random_mix_method  # type: ignore\n    import util_3d  # type: ignore\n\n    rng = random.Random(args.seed)\n\n    data_root = Path(args.data_root)\n    img_dir = data_root / \"images\"\n    lab_dir = data_root / \"labels\"\n\n    labeled_ids = read_list(args.labeled_list)\n    unlabeled_ids = read_list(args.unlabeled_list)\n\n    # shard unlabeled     "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nGenerate pseudo-labels for LLD-MMRI using SSL-MedSAM2's pseudo-logit ensembling.\n\nThis is an *adaptation wrapper* (LLD-MMRI specific) that reuses the original\nSSL-MedSAM2 code (dataloader_3d.py, random_mix_method.py, util_3d.py) without\nediting it, by importing it via sys.path.\n\nHigh-level:\n- Load labeled volumes (with GT masks) and unlabeled volumes (images only).\n- For each unlabeled volume, sample K labeled references.\n- For each labeled reference, run N random insert operations (whole_insert_a_to_b)\n  to produce multiple probability volumes (*.nii).\n- Ensemble those probability volumes into a single pseudo mask via util_3d.generate_uncert_and_pred,\n  saved as &lt;pred_dir&gt;/&lt;case_id&gt;.nii.gz (binary labels 0/1) + uncertainty map.\n\nNOTE:\n- This script can be very slow (SAM2 inference per volume). Use --max_unlabeled\n  and --part/--total_parts to parallelize across jobs.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport os\nimport random\nimport shutil\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport SimpleITK as sitk\nimport torch\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\n\nfrom sam2.build_sam import build_sam2_video_predictor_npz\n\n\ndef read_list(path: str) -&gt; list[str]:\n    with open(path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        return [ln.strip() for ln in f.readlines() if ln.strip()]\n\n\ndef main() -&gt; None:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--data_root\",\n        type=str,\n        default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/LLD-MMRI/LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2\",\n        help=\"LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2 root containing images/ and labels/\",\n    )\n    ap.add_argument(\"--labeled_list\", type=str, required=True, help=\"labeled.txt (case_id per line)\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--unlabeled_list\", type=str, required=True, help=\"unlabeled.txt (case_id per line)\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--ssl_code_dir\", type=str, default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/SSL-MedSAM2\", help=\"Path to SSL-MedSAM2 repo\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--sam2_cfg\", type=str, default=\"configs/sam2.1_hiera_t512.yaml\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--sam2_checkpoint\", type=str, default=\"checkpoints/MedSAM2_latest.pt\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--img_size\", type=int, default=512)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--z_axis\", type=int, default=0)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=42)\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--num_ref_labeled\", type=int, default=3, help=\"How many labeled reference volumes to sample per unlabeled\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--n_inserts_per_ref\", type=int, default=5, help=\"How many random insert locations per ref (ensembling size)\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--total_parts\", type=int, default=1, help=\"Split unlabeled list into N parts for parallel runs\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--part\", type=int, default=0, help=\"Which part index to run (0..total_parts-1)\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--max_unlabeled\", type=int, default=-1, help=\"Limit # unlabeled cases (after part split); -1 for all\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--work_dir\", type=str, default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/exp_log/LLDMMRI_SSL\", help=\"Working/output root\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--only_largest_comp\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Keep only largest connected component in pseudo mask\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    # Import SSL-MedSAM2 modules without copying into MedSAM2\n    sys.path.insert(0, args.ssl_code_dir)\n    from dataloader_3d import MedicalVolumeDataset  # type: ignore\n    from dataloader_3d import preprocess as ssl_preprocess  # type: ignore\n    from dataloader_3d import resize_grayscale_to_rgb_and_resize as ssl_resize_to_rgb  # type: ignore\n    from dataloader_3d import data_normalization as ssl_data_norm  # type: ignore\n    import random_mix_method  # type: ignore\n    import util_3d  # type: ignore\n\n    rng = random.Random(args.seed)\n\n    data_root = Path(args.data_root)\n    img_dir = data_root / \"images\"\n    lab_dir = data_root / \"labels\"\n\n    labeled_ids = read_list(args.labeled_list)\n    unlabeled_ids = read_list(args.unlabeled_list)\n\n    # shard unlabeled list\n    if args.total_parts &gt; 1:\n        parts = np.array_split(np.array(unlabeled_ids, dtype=object), args.total_parts)\n        unlabeled_ids = list(parts[args.part].tolist())\n    if args.max_unlabeled and args.max_unlabeled &gt; 0:\n        unlabeled_ids = unlabeled_ids[: args.max_unlabeled]\n\n    # path dicts required by MedicalVolumeDataset\n    img_path_dict_la = {cid: str(img_dir / f\"{cid}_0000.nii.gz\") for cid in labeled_ids}\n    img_path_dict_un = {cid: str(img_dir / f\"{cid}_0000.nii.gz\") for cid in unlabeled_ids}\n    mask_path_dict = {cid: str(lab_dir / f\"{cid}.nii.gz\") for cid in labeled_ids}\n\n    # instantiate SAM2 predictor\n    predictor = build_sam2_video_predictor_npz(args.sam2_cfg, args.sam2_checkpoint)\n\n    labelled_dataset = MedicalVolumeDataset(\n        labeled_ids,\n        img_path_dict_la,\n        img_size=args.img_size,\n        modality=\"MRI\",\n        z_axis=args.z_axis,\n    )\n    unlabelled_dataset = MedicalVolumeDataset(\n        unlabeled_ids,\n        img_path_dict_un,\n        img_size=args.img_size,\n        modality=\"MRI\",\n        z_axis=args.z_axis,\n    )\n\n    def load_volume_tensor(case_id: str) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n        \"\"\"Load and preprocess a NIfTI volume into (D,3,img_size,img_size) torch tensor.\"\"\"\n        p = img_dir / f\"{case_id}_0000.nii.gz\"\n        if not p.exists():\n            p = img_dir / f\"{case_id}_0000.nii\"\n        if not p.exists():\n            raise FileNotFoundError(f\"Missing image for {case_id}: {p}\")\n        nii = sitk.ReadImage(str(p))\n        arr = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(nii)  # (D,H,W)\n        if args.z_axis != 0:\n            arr = np.moveaxis(arr, args.z_axis, 0)\n        arr = ssl_preprocess(arr, modality=\"MRI\")\n        arr_rgb, _, _ = ssl_resize_to_rgb(arr, args.img_size)  # (D,3,S,S)\n        t = torch.from_numpy(arr_rgb)\n        t = ssl_data_norm(t)\n        return t\n\n    # output dirs\n    work_dir = Path(args.work_dir)\n    tmp_logits_dir = work_dir / \"tmp_logits\"\n    pred_dir = work_dir / \"pseudo_masks\"\n    uncert_dir = work_dir / \"uncertainty\"\n    tmp_logits_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    pred_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    uncert_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n    print(f\"LLD-MMRI SSL pseudo generation\")\n    print(f\"- labeled: {len(labeled_ids)}\")\n    print(f\"- unlabeled(part={args.part}/{args.total_parts}): {len(unlabeled_ids)}\")\n    print(f\"- outputs: {work_dir}\")\n\n    # main loop\n    for idx_un, sample_un in enumerate(unlabelled_dataset, start=1):\n        if sample_un is None:\n            continue\n        obj_un = sample_un[\"obj\"]\n        volume_un: torch.Tensor = sample_un[\"img_data\"]\n        nii_un = sample_un[\"img_nii\"]\n        n_slices = volume_un.size(0)\n        video_width_un = int(sample_un[\"video_width\"])\n        video_height_un = int(sample_un[\"video_height\"])\n\n        # skip if already generated\n        out_mask_path = pred_dir / f\"{obj_un}.nii.gz\"\n        if out_mask_path.exists():\n            print(f\"[{idx_un}/{len(unlabeled_ids)}] skip exists: {obj_un}\")\n            continue\n\n        # sample reference labeled cases\n        ref_ids = rng.sample(labeled_ids, k=min(args.num_ref_labeled, len(labeled_ids)))\n        print(f\"[{idx_un}/{len(unlabeled_ids)}] generating pseudo for {obj_un} using refs={len(ref_ids)}\")\n\n        # clean tmp dir per case\n        if tmp_logits_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(tmp_logits_dir)\n        tmp_logits_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n        # generate N insert-based probability volumes\n        for obj_la in ref_ids:\n            # load and resize GT mask (binary) to match unlabelled original size\n            mask_la_img = sitk.ReadImage(mask_path_dict[obj_la])\n            mask_la = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(mask_la_img)\n            mask_la = (mask_la &gt; 0).astype(np.uint8)  # (D,H,W)\n\n            mask_la = (\n                F.interpolate(\n                    torch.from_numpy(mask_la).unsqueeze(1),\n                    size=(video_height_un, video_width_un),\n                    mode=\"nearest\",\n                )\n                .squeeze(1)\n                .numpy()\n                .astype(np.uint8)\n            )\n\n            # Load labeled volume on demand (avoid iterating the entire labeled dataset)\n            volume_la: torch.Tensor = load_volume_tensor(obj_la)\n\n            random_mix_method.whole_insert_a_to_b(\n                rng,\n                obj_la=obj_la,\n                cl=[1],\n                mod=\"la_to_un\",\n                volume_a=volume_la,\n                volume_b=volume_un,\n                mask_la=mask_la,\n                n_sampling_on_each_mask=args.n_inserts_per_ref,\n                predictor=predictor,\n                video_height_un=video_height_un,\n                video_width_un=video_width_un,\n                prompt_points=None,\n                prompt_bbox=None,\n                save_npz_dir=str(tmp_logits_dir),\n            )\n\n        # ensemble &amp; write final pseudo mask + uncertainty\n        util_3d.generate_uncert_and_pred(\n            obj_un,\n            nii_un,\n            n_slices,\n            ori_size=(video_height_un, video_width_un),\n            img_size=args.img_size,\n            pred_npz_dir=str(tmp_logits_dir),\n            uncertainty_dir=str(uncert_dir),\n            pred_dir=str(pred_dir),\n            only_largest_comp=args.only_largest_comp,\n        )\n\n    print(\"Done. Pseudo masks at:\", str(pred_dir))\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n\n",
    "languageId": "python"
  }
}

  continue\n\n        # sample reference labeled cases\n        ref_ids = rng.sample(labeled_ids, k=min(args.num_ref_labeled, len(labeled_ids)))\n        print(f\"[{idx_un}/{len(unlabeled_ids)}] generating pseudo for {obj_un} using refs={len(ref_ids)}\")\n\n        # clean tmp dir per case\n        if tmp_logits_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(tmp_logits_dir)\n        tmp_logits_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n        # generate N insert-based probability volumes\n        for obj_la in ref_ids:\n            # load and resize GT mask (binary) to match unlabelled original size\n            mask_la_img = sitk.ReadImage(mask_path_dict[obj_la])\n            mask_la = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(mask_la_img)\n            mask_la = (mask_la &gt; 0).astype(np.uint8)  # (D,H,W)\n\n            mask_la = (\n                F.interpolate(\n                    torch.from_numpy(mask_la).unsqueeze(1),\n                    size=(video_height_un, video_width_un),\n                    mode=\"nearest\",\n                )\n                .squeeze(1)\n                .numpy()\n                .astype(np.uint8)\n            )\n\n            # Load labeled volume on demand (avoid iterating the entire labeled dataset)\n            volume_la: torch.Tensor = load_volume_tensor(obj_la)\n\n            random_mix_method.whole_insert_a_to_b(\n                rng,\n                obj_la=obj_la,\n                cl=[1],\n                mod=\"la_to_un\",\n                volume_a=volume_la,\n                volume_b=volume_un,\n                mask_la=mask_la,\n                n_sampling_on_each_mask=args.n_inserts_per_ref,\n                predictor=predictor,\n                video_height_un=video_height_un,\n                video_width_un=video_width_un,\n                prompt_points=None,\n                prompt_bbox=None,\n                save_npz_dir=str(tmp_logits_dir),\n            )\n\n        # ensemble &amp; write final pseudo mask + uncertainty\n        util_3d.generate_uncert_and_pred(\n            obj_un,\n            nii_un,\n            n_slices,\n            ori_size=(video_height_un, video_width_un),\n            img_size=args.img_size,\n            pred_npz_dir=str(tmp_logits_dir),\n            uncertainty_dir=str(uncert_dir),\n            pred_dir=str(pred_dir),\n            only_largest_comp=args.only_largest_comp,\n        )\n\n    print(\"Done. Pseudo masks at:\", str(pred_dir))\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n\n"
}

    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nPrepare nnUNetv2 raw dataset folders from LLD-MMRI NIfTI volumes.\n\nWe create a clean nnUNet ID scheme (case_000001, ...) because original IDs contain '+' and '-'.\n\nOutputs:\n&lt;nnunet_raw&gt;/Dataset&lt;id&gt;_LLDMMRI/\n  imagesTr/  case_000001_0000.nii.gz ...\n  labelsTr/  case_000001.nii.gz ...\n  imagesTs/  case_000101_0000.nii.gz ...   (optional)\n  dataset.json\n  case_mapping.csv  (nnunet_id, original_case_id, split)\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport csv\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\ndef read_list(path: str) -&gt; list[str]:\n    with open(path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        return [ln.strip() for ln in f.readlines() if ln.strip()]\n\n\ndef ensure_link_or_copy(src: str, dst: str, copy: bool) -&gt; None:\n    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)\n    if os.path.exists(dst):\n        return\n    if copy:\n        import shutil\n\n        shutil.copy2(src, dst)\n        return\n    os.symlink(src, dst)\n\n\ndef main() -&gt; None:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--dataset_id\", type=int, default=701, help=\"nnUNet dataset numeric id\")\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--data_root\",\n        type=str,\n        default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/LLD-MMRI/LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2\",\n        help=\"Root folder containing images/ and labels/\",\n    )\n    ap.add_argument(\"--train_list\", type=str, required=True, help=\"train.txt (case_id per line)\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--val_list\", type=str, required=True, help=\"val.txt (case_id per line)\")\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--unlabeled_list\",\n        type=str,\n        default=None,\n        help=\"Optional unlabeled.txt. If provided with --pseudo_labels_dir, those cases will use pseudo labels.\",\n    )\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--pseudo_labels_dir\",\n        type=str,\n        default=None,\n        help=\"Folder containing pseudo masks named &lt;case_id&gt;.nii.gz (binary labels 0/1).\",\n    )\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--nnunet_raw\",\n        type=str,\n        default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/nnUNet_raw\",\n        help=\"nnUNet_raw directory\",\n    )\n    ap.add_argument(\"--copy\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Copy files instead of symlinks\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    train_ids = read_list(args.train_list)\n    val_ids = read_list(args.val_list)\n    unlabeled_set = set(read_list(args.unlabeled_list)) if args.unlabeled_list else set()\n    pseudo_dir = Path(args.pseudo_labels_dir) if args.pseudo_labels_dir else None\n\n    ds_name = f\"Dataset{args.dataset_id:03d}_LLDMMRI\"\n    ds_root = Path(args.nnunet_raw) / ds_name\n    imagesTr = ds_root / \"imagesTr\"\n    labelsTr = ds_root / \"labelsTr\"\n    imagesTs = ds_root / \"imagesTs\"\n    ds_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    imagesTr.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    labelsTr.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    imagesTs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n    img_dir = Path(args.data_root) / \"images\"\n    lab_dir = Path(args.data_root) / \"labels\"\n\n    mapping_path = ds_root / \"case_mapping.csv\"\n    with mapping_path.open(\"w\", newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        w = csv.writer(f)\n        w.writerow([\"nnunet_id\", \"original_case_id\", \"split\"])\n\n        def _emit(case_ids: list[str], split: str, start_index: int) -&gt; int:\n            idx = start_index\n            for case_id in case_ids:\n                nn_id = f\"case_{idx:06d}\"\n                # nnUNet expects *_0000 for modality channel 0\n                src_img = img_dir / f\"{case_id}_0000.nii.gz\"\n                if not src_img.exists():\n                    src_img = img_dir / f\"{case_id}_0000.nii\"\n                # label path: either GT (default) or pseudo label if requested\n                if pseudo_dir is not None and case_id in unlabeled_set:\n                    src_lab = pseudo_dir / f\"{case_id}.nii.gz\"\n                else:\n                    src_lab = lab_dir / f\"{case_id}.nii.gz\"\n                    if not src_lab.exists():\n                        src_lab = lab_dir / f\"{case_id}.nii\"\n\n                if not src_img.exists():\n                    raise FileNotFoundError(f\"Missing image: {src_img}\")\n                if not src_lab.exists():\n                    raise FileNotFoundError(f\"Missing label: {src_lab}\")\n\n                if split == \"train\":\n                    dst_img = imagesTr / f\"{nn_id}_0000.nii.gz\"\n                    dst_lab = labelsTr / f\"{nn_id}.nii.gz\"\n                    ensure_link_or_copy(str(src_img), str(dst_img), copy=args.copy)\n                    ensure_link_or_copy(str(src_lab), str(dst_lab), copy=args.copy)\n                elif split == \"val\":\n                    # put val into imagesTs by default, and keep labels in labelsTr for evaluation convenience\n                    dst_img = imagesTs / f\"{nn_id}_0000.nii.gz\"\n                    dst_lab = labelsTr / f\"{nn_id}.nii.gz\"\n                    ensure_link_or_copy(str(src_img), str(dst_img), copy=args.copy)\n                    ensure_link_or_copy(str(src_lab), str(dst_lab), copy=args.copy)\n                else:\n                    raise ValueError(split)\n\n                w.writerow([nn_id, case_id, split])\n                idx += 1\n            return idx\n\n        next_idx = _emit(train_ids, \"train\", start_index=1)\n        _emit(val_ids, \"val\", start_index=next_idx)\n\n    # dataset.json (binary segmentation)\n    dataset_json = ds_root / \"dataset.json\"\n    dataset_json.write_text(\n        \"{\\n\"\n        f'  \\\"name\\\": \\\"LLDMMRI\\\",\\n'\n        f'  \\\"description\\\": \\\"LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2 binary segmentation (prepared)\\\",\\n'\n        f'  \\\"tensorImageSize\\\": \\\"3D\\\",\\n'\n        f'  \\\"reference\\\": \\\"MedSAM2 / LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2\\\",\\n'\n        f'  \\\"licence\\\": \\\"unknown\\\",\\n'\n        f'  \\\"release\\\": \\\"1.0\\\",\\n'\n        f'  \\\"channel_names\\\": {{\\\"0\\\": \\\"MRI\\\"}},\\n'\n        f'  \\\"labels\\\": {{\\\"background\\\": 0, \\\"lesion\\\": 1}},\\n'\n        f'  \\\"numTraining\\\": {len(train_ids)},\\n'\n        f'  \\\"numTest\\\": {len(val_ids)}\\n'\n        \"}\\n\",\n        encoding=\"utf-8\",\n    )\n\n    print(\"nnUNet dataset prepared at:\", str(ds_root))\n    print(\"mapping:\", str(mapping_path))\n    print(\"train:\", len(train_ids), \"val(as test):\", len(val_ids))\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n\n",
    "languageId": "python"
  }
}

    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nGenerate pseudo-labels for LLD-MMRI using SSL-MedSAM2's pseudo-logit ensembling.\n\nThis is an *adaptation wrapper* (LLD-MMRI specific) that reuses the original\nSSL-MedSAM2 code (dataloader_3d.py, random_mix_method.py, util_3d.py) without\nediting it, by importing it via sys.path.\n\nHigh-level:\n- Load labeled volumes (with GT masks) and unlabeled volumes (images only).\n- For each unlabeled volume, sample K labeled references.\n- For each labeled reference, run N random insert operations (whole_insert_a_to_b)\n  to produce multiple probability volumes (*.nii).\n- Ensemble those probability volumes into a single pseudo mask via util_3d.generate_uncert_and_pred,\n  saved as &lt;pred_dir&gt;/&lt;case_id&gt;.nii.gz (binary labels 0/1) + uncertainty map.\n\nNOTE:\n- This script can be very slow (SAM2 inference per volume). Use --max_unlabeled\n  and --part/--total_parts to parallelize across jobs.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport os\nimport random\nimport shutil\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport SimpleITK as sitk\nimport torch\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\n\n# Ensure MedSAM2 repo root is importable even when executed from another cwd\n_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]\nsys.path.insert(0, str(_REPO_ROOT))\n\nfrom sam2.build_sam import build_sam2_video_predictor_npz\n\n\ndef read_list(path: str) -&gt; list[str]:\n    with open(path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        return [ln.strip() for ln in f.readlines() if ln.strip()]\n\n\ndef main() -&gt; None:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--data_root\",\n        type=str,\n        default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/LLD-MMRI/LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2\",\n        help=\"LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2 root containing images/ and labels/\",\n    )\n    ap.add_argument(\"--labeled_list\", type=str, required=True, help=\"labeled.txt (case_id per line)\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--unlabeled_list\", type=str, required=True, help=\"unlabeled.txt (case_id per line)\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--ssl_code_dir\", type=str, default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/SSL-MedSAM2\", help=\"Path to SSL-MedSAM2 repo\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--sam2_cfg\", type=str, default=\"configs/sam2.1_hiera_t512.yaml\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--sam2_checkpoint\", type=str, default=\"checkpoints/MedSAM2_latest.pt\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--img_size\", type=int, default=512)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--z_axis\", type=int, default=0)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=42)\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--num_ref_labeled\", type=int, default=3, help=\"How many labeled reference volumes to sample per unlabeled\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--n_inserts_per_ref\", type=int, default=5, help=\"How many random insert locations per ref (ensembling size)\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--total_parts\", type=int, default=1, help=\"Split unlabeled list into N parts for parallel runs\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--part\", type=int, default=0, help=\"Which part index to run (0..total_parts-1)\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--max_unlabeled\", type=int, default=-1, help=\"Limit # unlabeled cases (after part split); -1 for all\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--work_dir\", type=str, default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/exp_log/LLDMMRI_SSL\", help=\"Working/output root\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--only_largest_comp\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Keep only largest connected component in pseudo mask\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    # Import SSL-MedSAM2 modules without copying into MedSAM2\n    sys.path.insert(0, args.ssl_code_dir)\n    from dataloader_3d import MedicalVolumeDataset  # type: ignore\n    from dataloader_3d import preprocess as ssl_preprocess  # type: ignore\n    from dataloader_3d import resize_grayscale_to_rgb_and_resize as ssl_resize_to_rgb  # type: ignore\n    from dataloader_3d import data_normalization as ssl_data_norm  # type: ignore\n    import random_mix_method  # type: ignore\n    import util_3d  # type: ignore\n\n    rng = random.Random(args.seed)\n\n    data_root = Path(args.data_root)\n    img_dir = data_root / \"images\"\n    lab_dir = data_root / \"labels\"\n\n    labeled_ids = read_list(args.labeled_list)\n    unlabeled_ids = read_list(args.unlabeled_list)\n\n    # shard unlabeled list\n    if args.total_parts &gt; 1:\n        parts = np.array_split(np.array(unlabeled_ids, dtype=object), args.total_parts)\n        unlabeled_ids = list(parts[args.part].tolist())\n    if args.max_unlabeled and args.max_unlabeled &gt; 0:\n        unlabeled_ids = unlabeled_ids[: args.max_unlabeled]\n\n    # path dicts required by MedicalVolumeDataset\n    img_path_dict_la = {cid: str(img_dir / f\"{cid}_0000.nii.gz\") for cid in labeled_ids}\n    img_path_dict_un = {cid: str(img_dir / f\"{cid}_0000.nii.gz\") for cid in unlabeled_ids}\n    mask_path_dict = {cid: str(lab_dir / f\"{cid}.nii.gz\") for cid in labeled_ids}\n\n    # instantiate SAM2 predictor\n    predictor = build_sam2_video_predictor_npz(args.sam2_cfg, args.sam2_checkpoint)\n\n    labelled_dataset = MedicalVolumeDataset(\n        labeled_ids,\n        img_path_dict_la,\n        img_size=args.img_size,\n        modality=\"MRI\",\n        z_axis=args.z_axis,\n    )\n    unlabelled_dataset = MedicalVolumeDataset(\n        unlabeled_ids,\n        img_path_dict_un,\n        img_size=args.img_size,\n        modality=\"MRI\",\n        z_axis=args.z_axis,\n    )\n\n    def load_volume_tensor(case_id: str) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n        \"\"\"Load and preprocess a NIfTI volume into (D,3,img_size,img_size) torch tensor.\"\"\"\n        p = img_dir / f\"{case_id}_0000.nii.gz\"\n        if not p.exists():\n            p = img_dir / f\"{case_id}_0000.nii\"\n        if not p.exists():\n            raise FileNotFoundError(f\"Missing image for {case_id}: {p}\")\n        nii = sitk.ReadImage(str(p))\n        arr = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(nii)  # (D,H,W)\n        if args.z_axis != 0:\n            arr = np.moveaxis(arr, args.z_axis, 0)\n        arr = ssl_preprocess(arr, modality=\"MRI\")\n        arr_rgb, _, _ = ssl_resize_to_rgb(arr, args.img_size)  # (D,3,S,S)\n        t = torch.from_numpy(arr_rgb)\n        t = ssl_data_norm(t)\n        return t\n\n    # output dirs\n    work_dir = Path(args.work_dir)\n    tmp_logits_dir = work_dir / \"tmp_logits\"\n    pred_dir = work_dir / \"pseudo_masks\"\n    uncert_dir = work_dir / \"uncertainty\"\n    tmp_logits_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    pred_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    uncert_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n    print(f\"LLD-MMRI SSL pseudo generation\")\n    print(f\"- labeled: {len(labeled_ids)}\")\n    print(f\"- unlabeled(part={args.part}/{args.total_parts}): {len(unlabeled_ids)}\")\n    print(f\"- outputs: {work_dir}\")\n\n    # main loop\n    for idx_un, sample_un in enumerate(unlabelled_dataset, start=1):\n        if sample_un is None:\n            continue\n        obj_un = sample_un[\"obj\"]\n        volume_un: torch.Tensor = sample_un[\"img_data\"]\n        nii_un = sample_un[\"img_nii\"]\n        n_slices = volume_un.size(0)\n        video_width_un = int(sample_un[\"video_width\"])\n        video_height_un = int(sample_un[\"video_height\"])\n\n        # skip if already generated\n        out_mask_path = pred_dir / f\"{obj_un}.nii.gz\"\n        if out_mask_path.exists():\n            print(f\"[{idx_un}/{len(unlabeled_ids)}] skip exists: {obj_un}\")\n            continue\n\n        # sample reference labeled cases\n        ref_ids = rng.sample(labeled_ids, k=min(args.num_ref_labeled, len(labeled_ids)))\n        print(f\"[{idx_un}/{len(unlabeled_ids)}] generating pseudo for {obj_un} using refs={len(ref_ids)}\")\n\n        # clean tmp dir per case\n        if tmp_logits_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(tmp_logits_dir)\n        tmp_logits_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n        # generate N insert-based probability volumes\n        for obj_la in ref_ids:\n            # load and resize GT mask (binary) to match unlabelled original size\n            mask_la_img = sitk.ReadImage(mask_path_dict[obj_la])\n            mask_la = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(mask_la_img)\n            mask_la = (mask_la &gt; 0).astype(np.uint8)  # (D,H,W)\n\n            mask_la = (\n                F.interpolate(\n                    torch.from_numpy(mask_la).unsqueeze(1),\n                    size=(video_height_un, video_width_un),\n                    mode=\"nearest\",\n                )\n                .squeeze(1)\n                .numpy()\n                .astype(np.uint8)\n            )\n\n            # Load labeled volume on demand (avoid iterating the entire labeled dataset)\n            volume_la: torch.Tensor = load_volume_tensor(obj_la)\n\n            random_mix_method.whole_insert_a_to_b(\n                rng,\n                obj_la=obj_la,\n                cl=[1],\n                mod=\"la_to_un\",\n                volume_a=volume_la,\n                volume_b=volume_un,\n                mask_la=mask_la,\n                n_sampling_on_each_mask=args.n_inserts_per_ref,\n                predictor=predictor,\n                video_height_un=video_height_un,\n                video_width_un=video_width_un,\n                prompt_points=None,\n                prompt_bbox=None,\n                save_npz_dir=str(tmp_logits_dir),\n            )\n\n        # ensemble &amp; write final pseudo mask + uncertainty\n        util_3d.generate_uncert_and_pred(\n            obj_un,\n            nii_un,\n            n_slices,\n            ori_size=(video_height_un, video_width_un),\n            img_size=args.img_size,\n            pred_npz_dir=str(tmp_logits_dir),\n            uncertainty_dir=str(uncert_dir),\n            pred_dir=str(pred_dir),\n            only_largest_comp=args.only_largest_comp,\n        )\n\n    print(\"Done. Pseudo masks at:\", str(pred_dir))\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n\n",
    "languageId": "python"
  }
}

    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nGenerate pseudo-labels for LLD-MMRI using SSL-MedSAM2's pseudo-logit ensembling.\n\nThis is an *adaptation wrapper* (LLD-MMRI specific) that reuses the original\nSSL-MedSAM2 code (dataloader_3d.py, random_mix_method.py, util_3d.py) without\nediting it, by importing it via sys.path.\n\nHigh-level:\n- Load labeled volumes (with GT masks) and unlabeled volumes (images only).\n- For each unlabeled volume, sample K labeled references.\n- For each labeled reference, run N random insert operations (whole_insert_a_to_b)\n  to produce multiple probability volumes (*.nii).\n- Ensemble those probability volumes into a single pseudo mask via util_3d.generate_uncert_and_pred,\n  saved as &lt;pred_dir&gt;/&lt;case_id&gt;.nii.gz (binary labels 0/1) + uncertainty map.\n\nNOTE:\n- This script can be very slow (SAM2 inference per volume). Use --max_unlabeled\n  and --part/--total_parts to parallelize across jobs.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport os\nimport random\nimport shutil\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport SimpleITK as sitk\nimport torch\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\n\n# Ensure MedSAM2 repo root is importable even when executed from another cwd\n_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]\nsys.path.insert(0, str(_REPO_ROOT))\n\nfrom sam2.build_sam import build_sam2_video_predictor_npz\n\n\ndef read_list(path: str) -&gt; list[str]:\n    with open(path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        return [ln.strip() for ln in f.readlines() if ln.strip()]\n\n\ndef main() -&gt; None:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--data_root\",\n        type=str,\n        default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/LLD-MMRI/LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2\",\n        help=\"LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2 root containing images/ and labels/\",\n    )\n    ap.add_argument(\"--labeled_list\", type=str, required=True, help=\"labeled.txt (case_id per line)\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--unlabeled_list\", type=str, required=True, help=\"unlabeled.txt (case_id per line)\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--ssl_code_dir\", type=str, default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/SSL-MedSAM2\", help=\"Path to SSL-MedSAM2 repo\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--sam2_cfg\", type=str, default=\"configs/sam2.1_hiera_t512.yaml\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--sam2_checkpoint\", type=str, default=\"checkpoints/MedSAM2_latest.pt\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--img_size\", type=int, default=512)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--z_axis\", type=int, default=0)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=42)\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--num_ref_labeled\", type=int, default=3, help=\"How many labeled reference volumes to sample per unlabeled\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--n_inserts_per_ref\", type=int, default=5, help=\"How many random insert locations per ref (ensembling size)\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--total_parts\", type=int, default=1, help=\"Split unlabeled list into N parts for parallel runs\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--part\", type=int, default=0, help=\"Which part index to run (0..total_parts-1)\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--max_unlabeled\", type=int, default=-1, help=\"Limit # unlabeled cases (after part split); -1 for all\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--work_dir\", type=str, default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/exp_log/LLDMMRI_SSL\", help=\"Working/output root\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--only_largest_comp\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Keep only largest connected component in pseudo mask\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n    def _resolve_repo_path(p: str) -&gt; str:\n        if os.path.isabs(p):\n            return p\n        return str((_REPO_ROOT / p).resolve())\n\n    args.sam2_cfg = _resolve_repo_path(args.sam2_cfg)\n    args.sam2_checkpoint = _resolve_repo_path(args.sam2_checkpoint)\n\n\n    # Import SSL-MedSAM2 modules without copying into MedSAM2\n    sys.path.insert(0, args.ssl_code_dir)\n    from dataloader_3d import MedicalVolumeDataset  # type: ignore\n    from dataloader_3d import preprocess as ssl_preprocess  # type: ignore\n    from dataloader_3d import resize_grayscale_to_rgb_and_resize as ssl_resize_to_rgb  # type: ignore\n    from dataloader_3d import data_normalization as ssl_data_norm  # type: ignore\n    import random_mix_method  # type: ignore\n    import util_3d  # type: ignore\n\n    rng = random.Random(args.seed)\n\n    data_root = Path(args.data_root)\n    img_dir = data_root / \"images\"\n    lab_dir = data_root / \"labels\"\n\n    labeled_ids = read_list(args.labeled_list)\n    unlabeled_ids = read_list(args.unlabeled_list)\n\n    # shard unlabeled list\n    if args.total_parts &gt; 1:\n        parts = np.array_split(np.array(unlabeled_ids, dtype=object), args.total_parts)\n        unlabeled_ids = list(parts[args.part].tolist())\n    if args.max_unlabeled and args.max_unlabeled &gt; 0:\n        unlabeled_ids = unlabeled_ids[: args.max_unlabeled]\n\n    # path dicts required by MedicalVolumeDataset\n    img_path_dict_la = {cid: str(img_dir / f\"{cid}_0000.nii.gz\") for cid in labeled_ids}\n    img_path_dict_un = {cid: str(img_dir / f\"{cid}_0000.nii.gz\") for cid in unlabeled_ids}\n    mask_path_dict = {cid: str(lab_dir / f\"{cid}.nii.gz\") for cid in labeled_ids}\n\n    # instantiate SAM2 predictor\n    predictor = build_sam2_video_predictor_npz(args.sam2_cfg, args.sam2_checkpoint)\n\n    labelled_dataset = MedicalVolumeDataset(\n        labeled_ids,\n        img_path_dict_la,\n        img_size=args.img_size,\n        modality=\"MRI\",\n        z_axis=args.z_axis,\n    )\n    unlabelled_dataset = MedicalVolumeDataset(\n        unlabeled_ids,\n        img_path_dict_un,\n        img_size=args.img_size,\n        modality=\"MRI\",\n        z_axis=args.z_axis,\n    )\n\n    def load_volume_tensor(case_id: str) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n        \"\"\"Load and preprocess a NIfTI volume into (D,3,img_size,img_size) torch tensor.\"\"\"\n        p = img_dir / f\"{case_id}_0000.nii.gz\"\n        if not p.exists():\n            p = img_dir / f\"{case_id}_0000.nii\"\n        if not p.exists():\n            raise FileNotFoundError(f\"Missing image for {case_id}: {p}\")\n        nii = sitk.ReadImage(str(p))\n        arr = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(nii)  # (D,H,W)\n        if args.z_axis != 0:\n            arr = np.moveaxis(arr, args.z_axis, 0)\n        arr = ssl_preprocess(arr, modality=\"MRI\")\n        arr_rgb, _, _ = ssl_resize_to_rgb(arr, args.img_size)  # (D,3,S,S)\n        t = torch.from_numpy(arr_rgb)\n        t = ssl_data_norm(t)\n        return t\n\n    # output dirs\n    work_dir = Path(args.work_dir)\n    tmp_logits_dir = work_dir / \"tmp_logits\"\n    pred_dir = work_dir / \"pseudo_masks\"\n    uncert_dir = work_dir / \"uncertainty\"\n    tmp_logits_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    pred_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    uncert_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n    print(f\"LLD-MMRI SSL pseudo generation\")\n    print(f\"- labeled: {len(labeled_ids)}\")\n    print(f\"- unlabeled(part={args.part}/{args.total_parts}): {len(unlabeled_ids)}\")\n    print(f\"- outputs: {work_dir}\")\n\n    # main loop\n    for idx_un, sample_un in enumerate(unlabelled_dataset, start=1):\n        if sample_un is None:\n            continue\n        obj_un = sample_un[\"obj\"]\n        volume_un: torch.Tensor = sample_un[\"img_data\"]\n        nii_un = sample_un[\"img_nii\"]\n        n_slices = volume_un.size(0)\n        video_width_un = int(sample_un[\"video_width\"])\n        video_height_un = int(sample_un[\"video_height\"])\n\n        # skip if already generated\n        out_mask_path = pred_dir / f\"{obj_un}.nii.gz\"\n        if out_mask_path.exists():\n            print(f\"[{idx_un}/{len(unlabeled_ids)}] skip exists: {obj_un}\")\n            continue\n\n        # sample reference labeled cases\n        ref_ids = rng.sample(labeled_ids, k=min(args.num_ref_labeled, len(labeled_ids)))\n        print(f\"[{idx_un}/{len(unlabeled_ids)}] generating pseudo for {obj_un} using refs={len(ref_ids)}\")\n\n        # clean tmp dir per case\n        if tmp_logits_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(tmp_logits_dir)\n        tmp_logits_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n        # generate N insert-based probability volumes\n        for obj_la in ref_ids:\n            # load and resize GT mask (binary) to match unlabelled original size\n            mask_la_img = sitk.ReadImage(mask_path_dict[obj_la])\n            mask_la = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(mask_la_img)\n            mask_la = (mask_la &gt; 0).astype(np.uint8)  # (D,H,W)\n\n            mask_la = (\n                F.interpolate(\n                    torch.from_numpy(mask_la).unsqueeze(1),\n                    size=(video_height_un, video_width_un),\n                    mode=\"nearest\",\n                )\n                .squeeze(1)\n                .numpy()\n                .astype(np.uint8)\n            )\n\n            # Load labeled volume on demand (avoid iterating the entire labeled dataset)\n            volume_la: torch.Tensor = load_volume_tensor(obj_la)\n\n            random_mix_method.whole_insert_a_to_b(\n                rng,\n                obj_la=obj_la,\n                cl=[1],\n                mod=\"la_to_un\",\n                volume_a=volume_la,\n                volume_b=volume_un,\n                mask_la=mask_la,\n                n_sampling_on_each_mask=args.n_inserts_per_ref,\n                predictor=predictor,\n                video_height_un=video_height_un,\n                video_width_un=video_width_un,\n                prompt_points=None,\n                prompt_bbox=None,\n                save_npz_dir=str(tmp_logits_dir),\n            )\n\n        # ensemble &amp; write final pseudo mask + uncertainty\n        util_3d.generate_uncert_and_pred(\n            obj_un,\n            nii_un,\n            n_slices,\n            ori_size=(video_height_un, video_width_un),\n            img_size=args.img_size,\n            pred_npz_dir=str(tmp_logits_dir),\n            uncertainty_dir=str(uncert_dir),\n            pred_dir=str(pred_dir),\n            only_largest_comp=args.only_largest_comp,\n        )\n\n    print(\"Done. Pseudo masks at:\", str(pred_dir))\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n\n",
    "languageId": "python"
  }
}

    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nGenerate pseudo-labels for LLD-MMRI using SSL-MedSAM2's pseudo-logit ensembling.\n\nThis is an *adaptation wrapper* (LLD-MMRI specific) that reuses the original\nSSL-MedSAM2 code (dataloader_3d.py, random_mix_method.py, util_3d.py) without\nediting it, by importing it via sys.path.\n\nHigh-level:\n- Load labeled volumes (with GT masks) and unlabeled volumes (images only).\n- For each unlabeled volume, sample K labeled references.\n- For each labeled reference, run N random insert operations (whole_insert_a_to_b)\n  to produce multiple probability volumes (*.nii).\n- Ensemble those probability volumes into a single pseudo mask via util_3d.generate_uncert_and_pred,\n  saved as &lt;pred_dir&gt;/&lt;case_id&gt;.nii.gz (binary labels 0/1) + uncertainty map.\n\nNOTE:\n- This script can be very slow (SAM2 inference per volume). Use --max_unlabeled\n  and --part/--total_parts to parallelize across jobs.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport os\nimport random\nimport shutil\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport SimpleITK as sitk\nimport torch\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\n\n# Ensure MedSAM2 repo root is importable even when executed from another cwd\n_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]\nsys.path.insert(0, str(_REPO_ROOT))\n\nfrom sam2.build_sam import build_sam2_video_predictor_npz\n\n\ndef read_list(path: str) -&gt; list[str]:\n    with open(path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        return [ln.strip() for ln in f.readlines() if ln.strip()]\n\n\ndef main() -&gt; None:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--data_root\",\n        type=str,\n        default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/data/LLD-MMRI/LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2\",\n        help=\"LLD-MMRI-MedSAM2 root containing images/ and labels/\",\n    )\n    ap.add_argument(\"--labeled_list\", type=str, required=True, help=\"labeled.txt (case_id per line)\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--unlabeled_list\", type=str, required=True, help=\"unlabeled.txt (case_id per line)\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--ssl_code_dir\", type=str, default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/SSL-MedSAM2\", help=\"Path to SSL-MedSAM2 repo\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--sam2_cfg\", type=str, default=\"configs/sam2.1_hiera_t512.yaml\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--sam2_checkpoint\", type=str, default=\"checkpoints/MedSAM2_latest.pt\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--img_size\", type=int, default=512)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--z_axis\", type=int, default=0)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=42)\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--num_ref_labeled\", type=int, default=3, help=\"How many labeled reference volumes to sample per unlabeled\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--n_inserts_per_ref\", type=int, default=5, help=\"How many random insert locations per ref (ensembling size)\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--total_parts\", type=int, default=1, help=\"Split unlabeled list into N parts for parallel runs\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--part\", type=int, default=0, help=\"Which part index to run (0..total_parts-1)\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--max_unlabeled\", type=int, default=-1, help=\"Limit # unlabeled cases (after part split); -1 for all\")\n\n    ap.add_argument(\"--work_dir\", type=str, default=\"/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/exp_log/LLDMMRI_SSL\", help=\"Working/output root\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--only_largest_comp\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Keep only largest connected component in pseudo mask\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n    def _resolve_repo_path(p: str) -&gt; str:\n        if os.path.isabs(p):\n            return p\n        return str((_REPO_ROOT / p).resolve())\n\n    # NOTE: Hydra config is loaded from the &#96;sam2&#96; config module, so &#96;sam2_cfg&#96; must be a\n    # config name like \"configs/sam2.1_hiera_t512.yaml\" (NOT an absolute filesystem path).\n    args.sam2_checkpoint = _resolve_repo_path(args.sam2_checkpoint)\n\n\n    # Import SSL-MedSAM2 modules without copying into MedSAM2\n    sys.path.insert(0, args.ssl_code_dir)\n    from dataloader_3d import MedicalVolumeDataset  # type: ignore\n    from dataloader_3d import preprocess as ssl_preprocess  # type: ignore\n    from dataloader_3d import resize_grayscale_to_rgb_and_resize as ssl_resize_to_rgb  # type: ignore\n    from dataloader_3d import data_normalization as ssl_data_norm  # type: ignore\n    import random_mix_method  # type: ignore\n    import util_3d  # type: ignore\n\n    rng = random.Random(args.seed)\n\n    data_root = Path(args.data_root)\n    img_dir = data_root / \"images\"\n    lab_dir = data_root / \"labels\"\n\n    labeled_ids = read_list(args.labeled_list)\n    unlabeled_ids = read_list(args.unlabeled_list)\n\n    # shard unlabeled list\n    if args.total_parts &gt; 1:\n        parts = np.array_split(np.array(unlabeled_ids, dtype=object), args.total_parts)\n        unlabeled_ids = list(parts[args.part].tolist())\n    if args.max_unlabeled and args.max_unlabeled &gt; 0:\n        unlabeled_ids = unlabeled_ids[: args.max_unlabeled]\n\n    # path dicts required by MedicalVolumeDataset\n    img_path_dict_la = {cid: str(img_dir / f\"{cid}_0000.nii.gz\") for cid in labeled_ids}\n    img_path_dict_un = {cid: str(img_dir / f\"{cid}_0000.nii.gz\") for cid in unlabeled_ids}\n    mask_path_dict = {cid: str(lab_dir / f\"{cid}.nii.gz\") for cid in labeled_ids}\n\n    # instantiate SAM2 predictor\n    predictor = build_sam2_video_predictor_npz(args.sam2_cfg, args.sam2_checkpoint)\n\n    labelled_dataset = MedicalVolumeDataset(\n        labeled_ids,\n        img_path_dict_la,\n        img_size=args.img_size,\n        modality=\"MRI\",\n        z_axis=args.z_axis,\n    )\n    unlabelled_dataset = MedicalVolumeDataset(\n        unlabeled_ids,\n        img_path_dict_un,\n        img_size=args.img_size,\n        modality=\"MRI\",\n        z_axis=args.z_axis,\n    )\n\n    def load_volume_tensor(case_id: str) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n        \"\"\"Load and preprocess a NIfTI volume into (D,3,img_size,img_size) torch tensor.\"\"\"\n        p = img_dir / f\"{case_id}_0000.nii.gz\"\n        if not p.exists():\n            p = img_dir / f\"{case_id}_0000.nii\"\n        if not p.exists():\n            raise FileNotFoundError(f\"Missing image for {case_id}: {p}\")\n        nii = sitk.ReadImage(str(p))\n        arr = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(nii)  # (D,H,W)\n        if args.z_axis != 0:\n            arr = np.moveaxis(arr, args.z_axis, 0)\n        arr = ssl_preprocess(arr, modality=\"MRI\")\n        arr_rgb, _, _ = ssl_resize_to_rgb(arr, args.img_size)  # (D,3,S,S)\n        t = torch.from_numpy(arr_rgb)\n        t = ssl_data_norm(t)\n        return t\n\n    # output dirs\n    work_dir = Path(args.work_dir)\n    tmp_logits_dir = work_dir / \"tmp_logits\"\n    pred_dir = work_dir / \"pseudo_masks\"\n    uncert_dir = work_dir / \"uncertainty\"\n    tmp_logits_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    pred_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    uncert_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n    print(f\"LLD-MMRI SSL pseudo generation\")\n    print(f\"- labeled: {len(labeled_ids)}\")\n    print(f\"- unlabeled(part={args.part}/{args.total_parts}): {len(unlabeled_ids)}\")\n    print(f\"- outputs: {work_dir}\")\n\n    # main loop\n    for idx_un, sample_un in enumerate(unlabelled_dataset, start=1):\n        if sample_un is None:\n            continue\n        obj_un = sample_un[\"obj\"]\n        volume_un: torch.Tensor = sample_un[\"img_data\"]\n        nii_un = sample_un[\"img_nii\"]\n        n_slices = volume_un.size(0)\n        video_width_un = int(sample_un[\"video_width\"])\n        video_height_un = int(sample_un[\"video_height\"])\n\n        # skip if already generated\n        out_mask_path = pred_dir / f\"{obj_un}.nii.gz\"\n        if out_mask_path.exists():\n            print(f\"[{idx_un}/{len(unlabeled_ids)}] skip exists: {obj_un}\")\n            continue\n\n        # sample reference labeled cases\n        ref_ids = rng.sample(labeled_ids, k=min(args.num_ref_labeled, len(labeled_ids)))\n        print(f\"[{idx_un}/{len(unlabeled_ids)}] generating pseudo for {obj_un} using refs={len(ref_ids)}\")\n\n        # clean tmp dir per case\n        if tmp_logits_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(tmp_logits_dir)\n        tmp_logits_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n        # generate N insert-based probability volumes\n        for obj_la in ref_ids:\n            # load and resize GT mask (binary) to match unlabelled original size\n            mask_la_img = sitk.ReadImage(mask_path_dict[obj_la])\n            mask_la = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(mask_la_img)\n            mask_la = (mask_la &gt; 0).astype(np.uint8)  # (D,H,W)\n\n            mask_la = (\n                F.interpolate(\n                    torch.from_numpy(mask_la).unsqueeze(1),\n                    size=(video_height_un, video_width_un),\n                    mode=\"nearest\",\n                )\n                .squeeze(1)\n                .numpy()\n                .astype(np.uint8)\n            )\n\n            # Load labeled volume on demand (avoid iterating the entire labeled dataset)\n            volume_la: torch.Tensor = load_volume_tensor(obj_la)\n\n            random_mix_method.whole_insert_a_to_b(\n                rng,\n                obj_la=obj_la,\n                cl=[1],\n                mod=\"la_to_un\",\n                volume_a=volume_la,\n                volume_b=volume_un,\n                mask_la=mask_la,\n                n_sampling_on_each_mask=args.n_inserts_per_ref,\n                predictor=predictor,\n                video_height_un=video_height_un,\n                video_width_un=video_width_un,\n                prompt_points=None,\n                prompt_bbox=None,\n                save_npz_dir=str(tmp_logits_dir),\n            )\n\n        # ensemble &amp; write final pseudo mask + uncertainty\n        util_3d.generate_uncert_and_pred(\n            obj_un,\n            nii_un,\n            n_slices,\n            ori_size=(video_height_un, video_width_un),\n            img_size=args.img_size,\n            pred_npz_dir=str(tmp_logits_dir),\n            uncertainty_dir=str(uncert_dir),\n            pred_dir=str(pred_dir),\n            only_largest_comp=args.only_largest_comp,\n        )\n\n    print(\"Done. Pseudo masks at:\", str(pred_dir))\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n\n",
    "languageId": "python"
  }
}

list\n    if args.total_parts &gt; 1:\n        parts = np.array_split(np.array(unlabeled_ids, dtype=object), args.total_parts)\n        unlabeled_ids = list(parts[args.part].tolist())\n    if load_volume_tensor(case_id: str) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n        \"\"\"Load and preprocess a NIfTI volume into (D,3,img_size,img_size) torch tensor.\"\"\"\n        p = img_dir / f\"{case_id}_0000.nii.gz\"\n        if not p.exists():\n            p = img_dir / f\"{case_id}_0000.nii\"\n        if not p.exists():\n            raise FileNotFoundError(f\"Missing image for {case_id}: {p}\")\n        nii = sitk.ReadImage(str(p))\n        arr = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(nii)  # (D,H,W)\n        if args.z_axis != 0:\n            arr = np.moveaxis(arr, args.z_axis, 0)\n        arr = ssl_preprocess(arr, modality=\"MRI\")\n        arr_rgb, _, _ = ssl_resize_to_rgb(arr, args.img_size)  # (D,3,S,S)\n        t = torch.from_numpy(arr_rgb)\n        t = ssl_data_norm(t)\n        return t\n\n    # output dirs\n    work_dir = Path(args.work_dir)\n    tmp_logits_dir = work_dir / \"tmp_logits\"\n    pred_dir = work_dir / \"pseudo_masks\"\n    uncert_dir = work_dir / \"uncertainty\"\n    tmp_logits_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    pred_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    uncert_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n    print(f\"LLD-MMRI SSL pseudo generation\")\n    print(f\"- labeled: {len(labeled_ids)}\")\n    print(f\"- unlabeled(part={args.part}/{args.total_parts}): {len(unlabeled_ids)}\")\n    print(f\"- outputs: {work_dir}\")\n\n    # main loop\n    for idx_un, sample_un in enumerate(unlabelled_dataset, start=1):\n        if sample_un is None:\n            continue\n        obj_un = sample_un[\"obj\"]\n        volume_un: torch.Tensor = sample_un[\"img_data\"]\n        nii_un = sample_un[\"img_nii\"]\n        n_slices = volume_un.size(0)\n        video_width_un = int(sample_un[\"video_width\"])\n        video_height_un = int(sample_un[\"video_height\"])\n\n        # skip if already generated\n        out_mask_path = pred_dir / f\"{obj_un}.nii.gz\"\n        if out_mask_path.exists():\n ### 现状确认（LLD-MMRI 这份数据很适合做 30% 半监督）
- **图像**：`images/<case_id>_0000.nii.gz`（3D，示例形状 `(70, 448, 448)`，uint8，范围 `[0,255]`）
- **标签**：`labels/<case_id>.nii.gz`（3D，**二分类**，unique=`[0,1]`）

这与 `SSL-MedSAM2` 的 3D NIfTI dataloader 很匹配，同时也能通过转换成 NPZ 用 `MedSAM2` 做“监督基线”对照。参考仓库：[`SSL-MedSAM2`](https://github.com/naisops/SSL-MedSAM2)、[`MedSAM2`](https://github.com/bowang-lab/MedSAM2/)、[`MedSAM2 README`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bowang-lab/MedSAM2/main/README.md)。

#### C1. 生成伪标签（建议分片并行）
脚本：
- `/root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/scripts/lld_mmri/ssl_generate_pseudo.py`

示例：把 2231 个 unlabeled 切成 8 片，跑第 0 片：
```bash

python /root/autodl-tmp/works/MedSAM2/scripts/lld_mmri/ssl_generate_pseudo.py \
  --labeled_list   $SPLIT_DIR/labeled.txt \
  --unlabeled_list $SPLIT_DIR/unlabeled.txt \
  --total_parts 8 --part 0 \
  --num_ref_labeled 3 \
