dy]\n            ex1 = torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * dx\n            ey1 = torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * dy\n            ex2 = torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * dx\n            ey2 = torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * dy\n            \n            if outward_only:\n                # outward: x1 decreases, y1 decreases, x2 increases, y2 increases\n                x1n = x1 - ex1\n                y1n = y1 - ey1\n                x2n = x2 + ex2\n                y2n = y2 + ey2\n            else:\n                # allow inward with small probability by random sign\n                s1 = torch.where(torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) &lt; 0.9, -1.0, 1.0)  # x1: outward is -1\n                t1 = torch.where(torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) &lt; 0.9, -1.0, 1.0)  # y1\n                s2 = torch.where(torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) &lt; 0.9, 1.0, -1.0)   # x2: outward is +1\n                t2 = torch.where(torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) &lt; 0.9, 1.0, -1.0)   # y2\n                x1n = x1 + s1 * ex1\n                y1n = y1 + t1 * ey1\n                x2n = x2 + s2 * ex2\n                y2n = y2 + t2 * ey2\n            \n            x1n = torch.clamp(x1n, 0, w - 1)\n            y1n = torch.clamp(y1n, 0, h - 1)\n            x2n = torch.clamp(x2n, 0, w - 1)\n            y2n = torch.clamp(y2n, 0, h - 1)\n            # ensure valid ordering\n            jittered[i] = torch.stack(\n                [torch.min(x1n, x2n), torch.min(y1n, y2n), torch.max(x1n, x2n), torch.max(y1n, y2n)]\n            ).squeeze()\n        return jittered\n    \n    @staticmethod\n    def _structure_loss_per_sample(logits: torch.Tensor, target: torch.Tensor) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n        \"\"\"\n        Per-sample StructureLoss (same as optim/losses/structure_loss.py) without final mean.\n        Returns tensor of shape (B,).\n        \"\"\"\n        if logits.dim() == 3:\n            logits = logits.unsqueeze(1)\n        if target.dim() == 3:\n            target = target.unsqueeze(1)\n        weit = 1 + 5 * torch.abs(F.avg_pool2d(target, kernel_size=31, stride=1, padding=15) - target)\n        wbce = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, target, reduction=\"none\")\n        wbce = (weit * wbce).sum(dim=(2, 3)) / weit.sum(dim=(2, 3)).clamp(min=1e-6)\n        probs = torch.sigmoid(logits)\n        inter = ((probs * target) * weit).sum(dim=(2, 3))\n        union = ((probs + target) * weit).sum(dim=(2, 3))\n        wiou = 1 - (inter + 1) / (union - inter + 1)\n        return (wbce + wiou).view(-1)\n    \n    @staticmethod\n    def _weak_box_losses(\n        logits: torch.Tensor,  # (B,1,H,W) or (B,H,W)\n        boxes: torch.Tensor,   # (B,4) x1,y1,x2,y2 in pixel coords\n        outside_weight: float = 1.0,\n        entropy_weight: float = 0.05,\n        tv_weight: float = 0.0,\n    ) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n        \"\"\"\n        Box-only weak supervision loss:\n        - outside-box should be background (0)\n        - inside-box entropy minimization (push confident predictions without assuming full positive)\n        - optional smoothness (TV) inside box\n        Returns scalar loss.\n        \"\"\"\n        if logits.dim() == 3:\n            logits = logits.unsqueeze(1)\n        b, _, h, w = logits.shape\n        device = logits.device\n        outside_weight = float(outside_weight)\n        entropy_weight = float(entropy_weight)\n        tv_weight = float(tv_weight)\n        \n        total = logits.new_tensor(0.0)\n        count = 0\n        for i in range(b):\n            x1, y1, x2, y2 = boxes[i]\n            if x2 &lt;= x1 or y2 &lt;= y1:\n                continue\n            # integer pixel bounds (inclusive)\n            x1i = int(torch.clamp(x1.round(), 0, w - 1).item())\n            y1i = int(torch.clamp(y1.round(), 0, h - 1).item())\n            x2i = int(torch.clamp(x2.round(), 0, w - 1).item())\n            y2i = int(torch.clamp(y2.round(), 0, h - 1).item())\n            if x2i &lt;= x1i or y2i &lt;= y1i:\n                continue\n            \n            logit = logits[i : i + 1]  # (1,1,H,W)\n            outside_mask = torch.ones((1, 1, h, w), device=device, dtype=logit.dtype)\n            outside_mask[:, :, y1i : y2i + 1, x1i : x2i + 1] = 0.0\n            inside_mask = 1.0 - outside_mask\n            \n            # Outside-box background constraint\n            if outside_weight &gt; 0:\n                zeros = torch.zeros_like(logit)\n                bce = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logit, zeros, reduction=\"none\")\n                outside_loss = (bce * outside_mask).sum() / outside_mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)\n            else:\n                outside_loss = logit.new_tensor(0.0)\n            \n            # Inside-box entropy minimization\n            if entropy_weight &gt; 0:\n                p = torch.sigmoid(logit).clamp(min=1e-6, max=1 - 1e-6)\n                ent = -(p * torch.log(p) + (1 - p) * torch.log(1 - p))\n                ent_loss = (ent * inside_mask).sum() / inside_mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)\n            else:\n                ent_loss = logit.new_tensor(0.0)\n            \n            # Total variation smoothness inside the box\n            if tv_weight &gt; 0:\n                p = torch.sigmoid(logit)\n                dy = torch.abs(p[:, :, 1:, :] - p[:, :, :-1, :])\n                dx = torch.abs(p[:, :, :, 1:] - p[:, :, :, :-1])\n                # match shapes with masks\n                inside_y = inside_mask[:, :, 1:, :]\n                inside_x = inside_mask[:, :, :, 1:]\n                tv = (dy * inside_y).sum() / inside_y.sum().clamp(min=1.0) + (dx * inside_x).sum() / inside_x.sum().clamp(min=1.0)\n            else:\n                tv = logit.new_tensor(0.0)\n            \n            total = total + outside_weight * outside_loss + entropy_weight * ent_loss + tv_weight * tv\n            count += 1\n        \n        if count == 0:\n            return logits.new_tensor(0.0)\n        return total / float(count)\n\n    def _predict_boxes_from_images(self, image_paths: list, target_h: int, target_w: int) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n        \"\"\"\n        Wrapper around train_bbox_predictor to predict boxes in pixel coords and scale to target size.\n        \"\"\"\n        import numpy as np\n        from PIL import Image\n        if self.train_bbox_predictor is None:\n            raise ValueError(\"train_bbox_predictor is required for mode='predict'\")\n        b = len(image_paths)\n        boxes = torch.zeros((b, 4), device=self.device, dtype=torch.float32)\n        for i, img_path in enumerate(image_paths):\n            if not img_path:\n                continue\n            try:\n                bbox_px = self.train_bbox_predictor.predict(img_path)\n                if bbox_px is None:\n                    continue\n                with Image.open(img_path) as img:\n                    orig_w, orig_h = img.size\n                scale_x = target_w / orig_w\n                scale_y = target_h / orig_h\n                x1 = bbox_px[0] * scale_x\n                y1 = bbox_px[1] * scale_y\n                x2 = bbox_px[2] * scale_x\n                y2 = bbox_px[3] * scale_y\n                x1 = max(0, min(x1, target_w - 1))\n                y1 = max(0, min(y1, target_h - 1))\n                x2 = max(0, min(x2, target_w - 1))\n                y2 = max(0, min(y2, target_h - 1))\n                x1, x2 = min(x1, x2), max(x1, x2)\n                y1, y2 = min(y1, y2), max(y1, y2)\n                boxes[i] = torch.tensor([x1, y1, x2, y2], device=self.device, dtype=torch.float32)\n            except Exception as e:\n                logger.warning(f\"Failed to predict bbox for {img_path}: {e}\")\n                continue\n        return boxes\n\n    def _apply_train_box_prompts(self, batch: Dict, label: torch.Tensor) -&gt; None:\n        \"\"\"\n        In-place box prompt injection for training (gt/noisy/mix/predict) and for semi/weak supervision.\n        This is factored out so GSPO/standard paths can share the same augmentation.\n        \"\"\"\n        cfg = self.train_box_prompt_cfg or {}\n        mode = cfg.get(\"mode\", \"off\")\n        if mode == \"off\" and \"semi_labeled_fraction\" not in cfg:\n            return\n\n        box_mode = None\n        if mode != \"off\":\n            p_no = max(float(cfg.get(\"p_no\", 0.0)), 0.0)\n            p_gt = max(float(cfg.get(\"p_gt\", 0.0)), 0.0)\n            p_noisy = max(float(cfg.get(\"p_noisy\", 0.0)), 0.0)\n            noise_frac = float(cfg.get(\"noise_frac\", 0.12))\n\n            if mode == \"mix\":\n                total = p_no + p_gt + p_noisy\n                if total &gt; 0:\n                    p_no, p_gt, p_noisy = [x / total for x in (p_no, p_gt, p_noisy)]\n                r = torch.rand(1).item()\n                if r &lt; p_no:\n                    box_mode = \"off\"\n                elif r &lt; p_no + p_gt:\n                    box_mode = \"gt\"\n                else:\n                    box_mode = \"noisy\"\n            elif mode == \"predict\":\n                box_mode = \"predict\"\n            else:\n                box_mode = mode\n        else:\n            noise_frac = float(cfg.get(\"noise_frac\", 0.12))\n\n        def _jitter_boxes(boxes: torch.Tensor, h: int, w: int, frac: float = 0.12) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n            \"\"\"Uniform jitter relative to box size.\"\"\"\n            jittered = boxes.clone()\n            for i in range(jittered.shape[0]):\n                x1, y1, x2, y2 = jittered[i]\n                if x2 &lt;= x1 or y2 &lt;= y1:\n                    continue\n                bw = (x2 - x1).clamp(min=1.0)\n                bh = (y2 - y1).clamp(min=1.0)\n                dx = bw * frac\n                dy = bh * frac\n                rx1 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dx\n                ry1 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dy\n                rx2 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dx\n                ry2 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dy\n                x1n = torch.clamp(x1 + rx1, 0, w - 1)\n                y1n = torch.clamp(y1 + ry1, 0, h - 1)\n                x2n = torch.clamp(x2 + rx2, 0, w - 1)\n                y2n = torch.clamp(y2 + ry2, 0, h - 1)\n                jittered[i] = torch.stack(\n                    [torch.min(x1n, x2n), torch.min(y1n, y2n), torch.max(x1n, x2n), torch.max(y1n, y2n)]\n                ).squeeze()\n            return jittered\n\n        if box_mode in [\"gt\", \"noisy\"]:\n            gt_boxes = self._compute_boxes_from_mask(label)\n            h, w = label.shape[-2], label.shape[-1]\n            if box_mode == \"noisy\":\n                gt_boxes = _jitter_boxes(gt_boxes, h=h, w=w, frac=noise_frac)\n            if not (gt_boxes.sum(dim=1) == 0).all():\n                batch[self.model.box_key] = gt_boxes.unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1,4)\n        elif box_mode == \"predict\":\n            image_path_key = self.model.image_path_key\n            image_paths = batch.get(image_path_key, [])\n            if image_paths:\n                h, w = label.shape[-2], label.shape[-1]\n                pred_boxes = self._predict_boxes_from_images(\n                    image_paths=image_paths, target_h=h, target_w=w\n                )\n                if not (pred_boxes.sum(dim=1) == 0).all():\n                    batch[self.model.box_key] = pred_boxes.unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1,4)\n\n    def _compute_loss(self, output: Dict, label: torch.Tensor, **kwargs):\n        loss = 0\n        for _, per_output in output.items():\n            weight = per_output[WEIGHT] if WEIGHT in per_output else 1\n            if isinstance(self.loss_func, Mask2FormerLoss):\n                mask_labels = [mask_labels.to(per_output[LOGITS]) for mask_labels in kwargs[\"mask_labels\"]]\n                dict_loss = self.loss_func(\n                    masks_queries_logits=per_output[LOGITS],  # bs, num_mask_tokens, height, width\n                    class_queries_logits=per_output[CLASS_LOGITS],  # bs, num_mask_tokens, num_classes\n                    mask_labels=mask_labels,\n                    class_labels=kwargs[\"class_labels\"],\n                )\n                for v in dict_loss.values():\n                    loss += v\n            else:\n                logits = per_output[LOGITS]\n                \n                # Handle SAM multi-class output format: combine mask and class predictions\n                # SAM multi-class outputs: LOGITS [B, num_mask_tokens, H, W] + CLASS_LOGITS [B, num_mask_tokens, num_classes+1]\n                # When num_mask_tokens == num_classes, we can use LOGITS directly as per-class masks\n                # Otherwise, we need to combine mask and class predictions\n                if CLASS_LOGITS in per_output:\n                    mask_logits = logits  # [B, num_mask_tokens, H, W]\n                    class_logits = per_output[CLASS_LOGITS]  # [B, num_mask_tokens, num_classes+1]\n                    \n                    # Apply semantic inference to combine mask and class predictions\n                    # This follows Mask2Former's approach: semantic_mask = einsum(softmax(class), sigmoid(mask))\n                    mask_cls = F.softmax(class_logits, dim=-1)[..., :-1]  # [B, num_mask_tokens, num_classes]\n                    mask_pred = torch.sigmoid(mask_logits)  # [B, num_mask_tokens, H, W]\n                    \n                    # Combine: for each pixel, sum over mask tokens weighted by class probability\n                    # semantic_mask[b, c, h, w] = sum_q(mask_cls[b, q, c] * mask_pred[b, q, h, w])\n                    logits = torch.einsum(\"bqc,bqhw-&gt;bchw\", mask_cls, mask_pred)\n                    \n                    # Convert probabilities back to logits for CrossEntropyLoss (add small epsilon to avoid log(0))\n                    logits = torch.log(logits.clamp(min=1e-7))\n                \n                loss += (\n                    self.loss_func(\n                        input=logits,\n                        target=label,\n                    )\n                    * weight\n                )\n            # MoE loss\n            if MOE_LOSS in per_output:\n                loss += per_output[MOE_LOSS]\n\n        return loss\n\n    def _compute_metric_score(\n        self,\n        metric: torchmetrics.Metric,\n        custom_metric_func: Callable,\n        logits: torch.Tensor,\n        label: torch.Tensor,\n        **kwargs,\n    ):\n        # For Mask2Former-style multi-class segmentation, &#96;logits&#96; here may be mask-token logits\n        # with shape [B, Q, H, W]. Metrics like IoU/DICE expect semantic class logits/probabilities\n        # [B, C, H, W]. We pass &#96;semantic_masks&#96; (already computed in the forward/postprocess)\n        # to ensure validation metrics match evaluation-time metrics.\n        if isinstance(metric, (Multiclass_IoU, Multiclass_DICE)):\n            metric.update(kwargs[\"semantic_masks\"], label)\n        else:\n            metric.update(logits.float(), label)\n\n    def _shared_step(\n        self,\n        batch: Dict,\n    ):\n        label = batch[self.model.label_key]\n        \n        # ---- Semi/weak supervision config (optional) ----\n        cfg = self.train_box_prompt_cfg or {}\n        semi_labeled_fraction = float(cfg.get(\"semi_labeled_fraction\", 1.0))\n        semi_labeled_seed = int(cfg.get(\"semi_labeled_seed\", 0))\n        weak_box_jitter_mode = str(cfg.get(\"weak_box_jitter_mode\", \"box\"))\n        weak_box_jitter_amount = float(cfg.get(\"weak_box_jitter_amount\", cfg.get(\"noise_frac\", 0.12)))\n        weak_box_outward_only = bool(cfg.get(\"weak_box_outward_only\", True))\n        weak_outside_w = float(cfg.get(\"weak_loss_outside_weight\", 1.0))\n        weak_entropy_w = float(cfg.get(\"weak_loss_entropy_weight\", 0.05))\n        weak_tv_w = float(cfg.get(\"weak_loss_tv_weight\", 0.0))\n        \n        # Determine which samples are \"labeled\" (for simulation) using stable hashing on image paths.\n        image_paths = batch.get(self.model.image_path_key, [])\n        if isinstance(image_paths, str):\n            image_paths = [image_paths]\n        labeled_mask = None\n        if self.training and semi_labeled_fraction &lt; 1.0:\n            labeled_mask = self._get_labeled_mask_from_paths(\n                image_paths=image_paths, labeled_fraction=semi_labeled_fraction, seed=semi_labeled_seed\n            )\n\n        # -------- Train-time box prompt injection (configurable) --------\n        # 控制项：self.train_box_prompt_cfg = {\n        #   mode: off / gt / noisy / mix / predict,\n        #   p_no, p_gt, p_noisy: 仅在 mode=mix 时生效并会归一化,\n        #   noise_frac: 噪声扰动比例（相对 bbox 宽高）\n        # }\n        # mode=predict: 使用 self.train_bbox_predictor 预测框作为 box prompt\n        if self.training:\n            mode = cfg.get(\"mode\", \"off\")\n            box_mode = None\n            if mode != \"off\":\n                p_no = max(float(cfg.get(\"p_no\", 0.0)), 0.0)\n                p_gt = max(float(cfg.get(\"p_gt\", 0.0)), 0.0)\n                p_noisy = max(float(cfg.get(\"p_noisy\", 0.0)), 0.0)\n                noise_frac = float(cfg.get(\"noise_frac\", 0.12))\n\n                if mode == \"mix\":\n                    total = p_no + p_gt + p_noisy\n                    if total &gt; 0:\n                        p_no, p_gt, p_noisy = [x / total for x in (p_no, p_gt, p_noisy)]\n                    r = torch.rand(1).item()\n                    if r &lt; p_no:\n                        box_mode = \"off\"\n                    elif r &lt; p_no + p_gt:\n                        box_mode = \"gt\"\n                    else:\n                        box_mode = \"noisy\"\n                elif mode == \"predict\":\n                    box_mode = \"predict\"\n                else:\n                    box_mode = mode\n\n            def _jitter_boxes(boxes: torch.Tensor, h: int, w: int, frac: float = 0.12) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n                \"\"\"Uniform jitter relative to box size.\"\"\"\n                jittered = boxes.clone()\n                for i in range(jittered.shape[0]):\n                    x1, y1, x2, y2 = jittered[i]\n                    if x2 &lt;= x1 or y2 &lt;= y1:\n                        continue\n                    bw = (x2 - x1).clamp(min=1.0)\n                    bh = (y2 - y1).clamp(min=1.0)\n                    dx = bw * frac\n                    dy = bh * frac\n                    rx1 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dx\n                    ry1 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dy\n                    rx2 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dx\n                    ry2 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dy\n                    x1n = torch.clamp(x1 + rx1, 0, w - 1)\n                    y1n = torch.clamp(y1 + ry1, 0, h - 1)\n                    x2n = torch.clamp(x2 + rx2, 0, w - 1)\n                    y2n = torch.clamp(y2 + ry2, 0, h - 1)\n                    jittered[i] = torch.stack(\n                        [torch.min(x1n, x2n), torch.min(y1n, y2n), torch.max(x1n, x2n), torch.max(y1n, y2n)]\n                    ).squeeze()\n                return jittered\n\n            def _predict_boxes_from_images(image_paths: list, target_h: int, target_w: int) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n                \"\"\"Use BBoxPromptPredictor to predict boxes from image paths.\n                \n                Args:\n                    image_paths: List of image file paths\n                    target_h: Target image height (model input size)\n                    target_w: Target image width (model input size)\n                \n                Returns:\n                    boxes: (B, 4) tensor in pixel coords, scaled to target_h x target_w\n                \"\"\"\n                import numpy as np\n                from PIL import Image\n                \n                if self.train_bbox_predictor is None:\n                    raise ValueError(\"train_bbox_predictor is required for mode='predict'\")\n                \n                b = len(image_paths)\n                boxes = torch.zeros((b, 4), device=label.device, dtype=torch.float32)\n                \n                for i, img_path in enumerate(image_paths):\n                    if not img_path:\n                        continue\n                    try:\n                        # predict() returns bbox in original image pixels: (x1, y1, x2, y2)\n                        bbox_px = self.train_bbox_predictor.predict(img_path)\n                        if bbox_px is None:\n                            continue\n                        \n                        # Get original image size to scale bbox to target size\n                        with Image.open(img_path) as img:\n                            orig_w, orig_h = img.size\n                        \n                        # Scale bbox from original coords to target coords\n                        scale_x = target_w / orig_w\n                        scale_y = target_h / orig_h\n                        x1 = bbox_px[0] * scale_x\n                        y1 = bbox_px[1] * scale_y\n                        x2 = bbox_px[2] * scale_x\n                        y2 = bbox_px[3] * scale_y\n                        \n                        # Clamp to valid range\n                        x1 = max(0, min(x1, target_w - 1))\n                        y1 = max(0, min(y1, target_h - 1))\n                        x2 = max(0, min(x2, target_w - 1))\n                        y2 = max(0, min(y2, target_h - 1))\n                        \n                        # Ensure x1 &lt; x2 and y1 &lt; y2\n                        x1, x2 = min(x1, x2), max(x1, x2)\n                        y1, y2 = min(y1, y2), max(y1, y2)\n                        \n                        boxes[i] = torch.tensor([x1, y1, x2, y2], device=label.device, dtype=torch.float32)\n                    except Exception as e:\n                        logger.warning(f\"Failed to predict bbox for {img_path}: {e}\")\n                        continue\n                \n                return boxes\n\n            # If semi/weak enabled: for \"unlabeled\" samples, force weak coarse boxes generated from GT bbox with outward-biased jitter.\n            if labeled_mask is not None and hasattr(self.model, gt_boxes_all.clone()\n                    boxes_for_batch[~labeled_mask] = weak_boxes[~labeled_mask]\n                    if not (boxes_for_batch.sum(dim=1) == 0).all():\n                        batch[self.model.box_key] = boxes_for_batch.unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1,4)\n\n            if box_mode in [\"gt\", \"noisy\"]:\n                gt_boxes = self._compute_boxes_from_mask(label)\n                h, w = label.shape[-2], label.shape[-1]\n                if box_mode == \"noisy\":\n                    gt_boxes = _jitter_boxes(gt_boxes, h=h, w=w, frac=noise_frac)\n                if not (gt_boxes.sum(dim=1) == 0).all():\n                    batch[self.model.box_key] = gt_boxes.unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1,4)\n            elif box_mode == \"predict\":\n                # Get image paths from batch\n                image_path_key = self.model.image_path_key\n                image_paths = batch.get(image_path_key, [])\n                if image_paths:\n                    h, w = label.shape[-2], label.shape[-1]\n                    pred_boxes = _predict_boxes_from_images(image_paths, target_h=h, target_w=w)\n                    if not (pred_boxes.sum(dim=1) == 0).all():\n                        batch[self.model.box_key] = pred_boxes.unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1,4)\n        # prepare_targets\n        output = run_model(self.model, batch)\n        \n        # ---- Loss: s1 = torch.where(torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) &lt; 0.9, -1.0, 1.0)  # x1: outward is -1\n                t1 = torch.where(torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) &lt; 0.9, -1.0, 1.0)  # y1\n                s2 = torch.where(torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) &lt; 0.9, 1.0, -1.0)   # x2: outward is +1\n                t2 = torch.where(torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) &lt; 0.9, 1.0, -1.0)   # y2\n                x1n = x1 + s1 * ex1\n                y1n = y1 + t1 * ey1\n                x2n = x2 + s2 * ex2\n                y2n = y2 + t2 * ey2\n            \n            x1n = torch.clamp(x1n, 0, w - 1)\n            y1n = torch.clamp(y1n, 0, h - 1)\n            x2n = torch.clamp(x2n, 0, w - 1)\n            y2n = torch.clamp(y2n, 0, h - 1)\n            # ensure valid ordering\n            jittered[i] = torch.stack(\n                [torch.min(x1n, x2n), torch.min(y1n, y2n), torch.max(x1n, x2n), torch.max(y1n, y2n)]\n            ).squeeze()\n        return jittered\n    \n    @staticmethod\n    def _structure_loss_per_sample(logits: torch.Tensor, target: torch.Tensor) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n        \"\"\"\n        Per-sample StructureLoss (same as optim/losses/structure_loss.py) without final mean.\n        Returns tensor of shape (B,).\n        \"\"\"\n        if logits.dim() == 3:\n            logits = logits.unsqueeze(1)\n        if target.dim() == 3:\n            target = target.unsqueeze(1)\n        weit = 1 + 5 * torch.abs(F.avg_pool2d(target, kernel_size=31, stride=1, padding=15) - target)\n        wbce = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, target, reduction=\"none\")\n        wbce = (weit * wbce).sum(dim=(2, 3)) / weit.sum(dim=(2, 3)).clamp(min=1e-6)\n        probs = torch.sigmoid(logits)\n        inter = ((probs * target) * weit).sum(dim=(2, 3))\n        union = ((probs + target) * weit).sum(dim=(2, 3))\n        wiou = 1 - (inter + 1) / (union - inter + 1)\n        return (wbce + wiou).view(-1)\n    \n    @staticmethod\n    def _weak_box_losses(\n        logits: torch.Tensor,  # (B,1,H,W) or (B,H,W)\n        boxes: torch.Tensor,   # (B,4) x1,y1,x2,y2 in pixel coords\n        outside_weight: float = 1.0,\n        entropy_weight: float = 0.05,\n        tv_weight: float = 0.0,\n    ) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n        \"\"\"\n        Box-only weak supervision loss:\n        - outside-box should be background (0)\n        - inside-box entropy minimization (push confident predictions without assuming full positive)\n        - optional smoothness (TV) inside box\n        Returns scalar loss.\n        \"\"\"\n        if logits.dim() == 3:\n            logits = logits.unsqueeze(1)\n        b, _, h, w = logits.shape\n        device = logits.device\n        outside_weight = float(outside_weight)\n        entropy_weight = float(entropy_weight)\n        tv_weight = float(tv_weight)\n        \n        total = logits.new_tensor(0.0)\n        count = 0\n        for i in range(b):\n            x1, y1, x2, y2 = boxes[i]\n            if x2 &lt;= x1 or y2 &lt;= y1:\n                continue\n            # integer pixel bounds (inclusive)\n            x1i = int(torch.clamp(x1.round(), 0, w - 1).item())\n            y1i = int(torch.clamp(y1.round(), 0, h - 1).item())\n            x2i = int(torch.clamp(x2.round(), 0, w - 1).item())\n            y2i = int(torch.clamp(y2.round(), 0, h - 1).item())\n            if x2i &lt;= x1i or y2i &lt;= y1i:\n                continue\n            \n            logit = logits[i : i + 1]  # (1,1,H,W)\n            outside_mask = torch.ones((1, 1, h, w), device=device, dtype=logit.dtype)\n            outside_mask[:, :, y1i : y2i + 1, x1i : x2i + 1] = 0.0\n            inside_mask = 1.0 - outside_mask\n            \n            # Outside-box background constraint\n            if outside_weight &gt; 0:\n                zeros = torch.zeros_like(logit)\n                bce = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logit, zeros, reduction=\"none\")\n                outside_loss = (bce * outside_mask).sum() / outside_mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)\n            else:\n                outside_loss = logit.new_tensor(0.0)\n            \n            # Inside-box entropy minimization\n            if entropy_weight &gt; 0:\n                p = torch.sigmoid(logit).clamp(min=1e-6, max=1 - 1e-6)\n                ent = -(p * torch.log(p) + (1 - p) * torch.log(1 - p))\n                ent_loss = (ent * inside_mask).sum() / inside_mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)\n            else:\n                ent_loss = logit.new_tensor(0.0)\n            \n            # Total variation smoothness inside the box\n            if tv_weight &gt; 0:\n                p = torch.sigmoid(logit)\n                dy = torch.abs(p[:, :, 1:, :] - p[:, :, :-1, :])\n                dx = torch.abs(p[:, :, :, 1:] - p[:, :, :, :-1])\n                # match shapes with masks\n                inside_y = inside_mask[:, :, 1:, :]\n                inside_x = inside_mask[:, :, :, 1:]\n                tv = (dy * inside_y).sum() / inside_y.sum().clamp(min=1.0) + (dx * inside_x).sum() / inside_x.sum().clamp(min=1.0)\n            else:\n                tv = logit.new_tensor(0.0)\n            \n            total = total + outside_weight * outside_loss + entropy_weight * ent_loss + tv_weight * tv\n            count += 1\n        \n        if count == 0:\n            return logits.new_tensor(0.0)\n        return total / float(count)\n\n    def _predict_boxes_from_images(self, image_paths: list, target_h: int, target_w: int) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n        \"\"\"\n        Wrapper around train_bbox_predictor to predict boxes in pixel coords and scale to target size.\n        \"\"\"\n        import numpy as np\n        from PIL import Image\n        if self.train_bbox_predictor is None:\n            raise ValueError(\"train_bbox_predictor is required for mode='predict'\")\n        b = len(image_paths)\n        boxes = torch.zeros((b, 4), device=self.device, dtype=torch.float32)\n        for i, img_path in enumerate(image_paths):\n            if not img_path:\n                continue\n            try:\n                bbox_px = self.train_bbox_predictor.predict(img_path)\n                if bbox_px is None:\n                    continue\n                with Image.open(img_path) as img:\n                    orig_w, orig_h = img.size\n                scale_x = target_w / orig_w\n                scale_y = target_h / orig_h\n                x1 = bbox_px[0] * scale_x\n                y1 = bbox_px[1] * scale_y\n                x2 = bbox_px[2] * scale_x\n                y2 = bbox_px[3] * scale_y\n                x1 = max(0, min(x1, target_w - 1))\n                y1 = max(0, min(y1, target_h - 1))\n                x2 = max(0, min(x2, target_w - 1))\n                y2 = max(0, min(y2, target_h - 1))\n                x1, x2 = min(x1, x2), max(x1, x2)\n                y1, y2 = min(y1, y2), max(y1, y2)\n                boxes[i] = torch.tensor([x1, y1, x2, y2], device=self.device, dtype=torch.float32)\n            except Exception as e:\n                logger.warning(f\"Failed to predict bbox for {img_path}: {e}\")\n                continue\n        return boxes\n\n    def _apply_train_box_prompts(self, batch: Dict, label: torch.Tensor) -&gt; None:\n        \"\"\"\n        In-place box prompt injection for training (gt/noisy/mix/predict) and for semi/weak supervision.\n        This is factored out so GSPO/standard paths can share the same augmentation.\n        \"\"\"\n        cfg = self.train_box_prompt_cfg or {}\n        mode = cfg.get(\"mode\", \"off\")\n        if mode == \"off\" and \"semi_labeled_fraction\" not in cfg:\n            return\n\n        box_mode = None\n        if mode != \"off\":\n            p_no = max(float(cfg.get(\"p_no\", 0.0)), 0.0)\n            p_gt = max(float(cfg.get(\"p_gt\", 0.0)), 0.0)\n            p_noisy = max(float(cfg.get(\"p_noisy\", 0.0)), 0.0)\n            noise_frac = float(cfg.get(\"noise_frac\", 0.12))\n\n            if mode == \"mix\":\n                total = p_no + p_gt + p_noisy\n                if total &gt; 0:\n                    p_no, p_gt, p_noisy = [x / total for x in (p_no, p_gt, p_noisy)]\n                r = torch.rand(1).item()\n                if r &lt; p_no:\n                    box_mode = \"off\"\n                elif r &lt; p_no + p_gt:\n                    box_mode = \"gt\"\n                else:\n                    box_mode = \"noisy\"\n            elif mode == \"predict\":\n                box_mode = \"predict\"\n            else:\n                box_mode = mode\n        else:\n            noise_frac = float(cfg.get(\"noise_frac\", 0.12))\n\n        def _jitter_boxes(boxes: torch.Tensor, h: int, w: int, frac: float = 0.12) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n            \"\"\"Uniform jitter relative to box size.\"\"\"\n            jittered = boxes.clone()\n            for i in range(jittered.shape[0]):\n                x1, y1, x2, y2 = jittered[i]\n                if x2 &lt;= x1 or y2 &lt;= y1:\n                    continue\n                bw = (x2 - x1).clamp(min=1.0)\n                bh = (y2 - y1).clamp(min=1.0)\n                dx = bw * frac\n                dy = bh * frac\n                rx1 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dx\n                ry1 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dy\n                rx2 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dx\n                ry2 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dy\n                x1n = torch.clamp(x1 + rx1, 0, w - 1)\n                y1n = torch.clamp(y1 + ry1, 0, h - 1)\n                x2n = torch.clamp(x2 + rx2, 0, w - 1)\n                y2n = torch.clamp(y2 + ry2, 0, h - 1)\n                jittered[i] = torch.stack(\n                    [torch.min(x1n, x2n), torch.min(y1n, y2n), torch.max(x1n, x2n), torch.max(y1n, y2n)]\n                ).squeeze()\n            return jittered\n\n        if box_mode in [\"gt\", \"noisy\"]:\n            gt_boxes = self._compute_boxes_from_mask(label)\n            h, w = label.shape[-2], label.shape[-1]\n            if box_mode == \"noisy\":\n                gt_boxes = _jitter_boxes(gt_boxes, h=h, w=w, frac=noise_frac)\n            if not (gt_boxes.sum(dim=1) == 0).all():\n                batch[self.model.box_key] = gt_boxes.unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1,4)\n        elif box_mode == \"predict\":\n            image_path_key = self.model.image_path_key\n            image_paths = batch.get(image_path_key, [])\n            if image_paths:\n                h, w = label.shape[-2], label.shape[-1]\n                pred_boxes = self._predict_boxes_from_images(\n                    image_paths=image_paths, target_h=h, target_w=w\n                )\n                if not (pred_boxes.sum(dim=1) == 0).all():\n                    batch[self.model.box_key] = pred_boxes.unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1,4)\n\n    def _compute_loss(self, output: Dict, label: torch.Tensor, **kwargs):\n        loss = 0\n        for _, per_output in output.items():\n            weight = per_output[WEIGHT] if WEIGHT in per_output else 1\n            if isinstance(self.loss_func, Mask2FormerLoss):\n                mask_labels = [mask_labels.to(per_output[LOGITS]) for mask_labels in kwargs[\"mask_labels\"]]\n                dict_loss = self.loss_func(\n                    masks_queries_logits=per_output[LOGITS],  # bs, num_mask_tokens, height, width\n                    class_queries_logits=per_output[CLASS_LOGITS],  # bs, num_mask_tokens, num_classes\n                    mask_labels=mask_labels,\n                    class_labels=kwargs[\"class_labels\"],\n                )\n                for v in dict_loss.values():\n                    loss += v\n            else:\n                logits = per_output[LOGITS]\n                \n                # Handle SAM multi-class output format: combine mask and class predictions\n                # SAM multi-class outputs: LOGITS [B, num_mask_tokens, H, W] + CLASS_LOGITS [B, num_mask_tokens, num_classes+1]\n                # When num_mask_tokens == num_classes, we can use LOGITS directly as per-class masks\n                # Otherwise, we need to combine mask and class predictions\n                if CLASS_LOGITS in per_output:\n                    mask_logits = logits  # [B, num_mask_tokens, H, W]\n                    class_logits = per_output[CLASS_LOGITS]  # [B, num_mask_tokens, num_classes+1]\n                    \n                    # Apply semantic inference to combine mask and class predictions\n                    # This follows Mask2Former's approach: semantic_mask = einsum(softmax(class), sigmoid(mask))\n                    mask_cls = F.softmax(class_logits, dim=-1)[..., :-1]  # [B, num_mask_tokens, num_classes]\n                    mask_pred = torch.sigmoid(mask_logits)  # [B, num_mask_tokens, H, W]\n                    \n                    # Combine: for each pixel, sum over mask tokens weighted by class probability\n                    # semantic_mask[b, c, h, w] = sum_q(mask_cls[b, q, c] * mask_pred[b, q, h, w])\n                    logits = torch.einsum(\"bqc,bqhw-&gt;bchw\", mask_cls, mask_pred)\n                    \n                    # Convert probabilities back to logits for CrossEntropyLoss (add small epsilon to avoid log(0))\n                    logits = torch.log(logits.clamp(min=1e-7))\n                \n                loss += (\n                    self.loss_func(\n                        input=logits,\n                        target=label,\n                    )\n                    * weight\n                )\n            # MoE loss\n            if MOE_LOSS in per_output:\n                loss += per_output[MOE_LOSS]\n\n        return loss\n\n    def _compute_metric_score(\n        self,\n        metric: torchmetrics.Metric,\n        custom_metric_func: Callable,\n        logits: torch.Tensor,\n        label: torch.Tensor,\n        **kwargs,\n    ):\n        # For Mask2Former-style multi-class segmentation, &#96;logits&#96; here may be mask-token logits\n        # with shape [B, Q, H, W]. We pass &#96;semantic_masks&#96; (already computed in the forward/postprocess)\n        # to ensure validation metrics match evaluation-time metrics.\n        if isinstance(metric, (Multiclass_IoU, Multiclass_DICE)):\n            metric.update(kwargs[\"semantic_masks\"], label)\n        else:\n            metric.update(logits.float(), label)\n\n    def _shared_step(\n        self,\n        batch: Dict,\n    ):\n        label = batch[self.model.label_key]\n        \n        # ---- Semi/weak supervision config (optional) ----\n        cfg = self.train_box_prompt_cfg or {}\n        semi_labeled_fraction = float(cfg.get(\"semi_labeled_fraction\", 1.0))\n        semi_labeled_seed = int(cfg.get(\"semi_labeled_seed\", 0))\n        weak_box_jitter_mode = str(cfg.get(\"weak_box_jitter_mode\", \"box\"))\n        weak_box_jitter_amount = float(cfg.get(\"weak_box_jitter_amount\", cfg.get(\"noise_frac\", 0.12)))\n        weak_box_outward_only = bool(cfg.get(\"weak_box_outward_only\", True))\n        weak_outside_w = float(cfg.get(\"weak_loss_outside_weight\", 1.0))\n        weak_entropy_w = float(cfg.get(\"weak_loss_entropy_weight\", 0.05))\n        weak_tv_w = float(cfg.get(\"weak_loss_tv_weight\", 0.0))\n        \n        # Determine which samples are \"labeled\" (for simulation) using stable hashing on image paths.\n        image_paths = batch.get(self.model.image_path_key, [])\n        if isinstance(image_paths, str):\n            image_paths = [image_paths]\n        labeled_mask = None\n        if self.training and semi_labeled_fraction &lt; 1.0:\n            labeled_mask = self._get_labeled_mask_from_paths(\n                image_paths=image_paths, labeled_fraction=semi_labeled_fraction, seed=semi_labeled_seed\n            )\n\n        # -------- Train-time box prompt injection (configurable) --------\n        # 控制项：self.train_box_prompt_cfg = {\n        #   mode: off / gt / noisy / mix / predict,\n        #   p_no, p_gt, p_noisy: 仅在 mode=mix 时生效并会归一化,\n        #   noise_frac: 噪声扰动比例（相对 bbox 宽高）\n        # }\n        # mode=predict: 使用 self.train_bbox_predictor 预测框作为 box prompt\n        if self.training:\n            mode = cfg.get(\"mode\", \"off\")\n            box_mode = None\n            if mode != \"off\":\n                p_no = max(float(cfg.get(\"p_no\", 0.0)), 0.0)\n                p_gt = max(float(cfg.get(\"p_gt\", 0.0)), 0.0)\n                p_noisy = max(float(cfg.get(\"p_noisy\", 0.0)), 0.0)\n                noise_frac = float(cfg.get(\"noise_frac\", 0.12))\n\n                if mode == \"mix\":\n                    total = p_no + p_gt + p_noisy\n                    if total &gt; 0:\n                        p_no, p_gt, p_noisy = [x / total for x in (p_no, p_gt, p_noisy)]\n                    r = torch.rand(1).item()\n                    if r &lt; p_no:\n                        box_mode = \"off\"\n                    elif r &lt; p_no + p_gt:\n                        box_mode = \"gt\"\n                    else:\n                        box_mode = \"noisy\"\n                elif mode == \"predict\":\n                    box_mode = \"predict\"\n                else:\n                    box_mode = mode\n\n            def _jitter_boxes(boxes: torch.Tensor, h: int, w: int, frac: float = 0.12) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n                \"\"\"Uniform jitter relative to box size.\"\"\"\n                jittered = boxes.clone()\n                for i in range(jittered.shape[0]):\n                    x1, y1, x2, y2 = jittered[i]\n                    if x2 &lt;= x1 or y2 &lt;= y1:\n                        continue\n                    bw = (x2 - x1).clamp(min=1.0)\n                    bh = (y2 - y1).clamp(min=1.0)\n                    dx = bw * frac\n                    dy = bh * frac\n                    rx1 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dx\n                    ry1 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dy\n                    rx2 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dx\n                    ry2 = (torch.rand(1, device=boxes.device) * 2 - 1) * dy\n                    x1n = torch.clamp(x1 + rx1, 0, w - 1)\n                    y1n = torch.clamp(y1 + ry1, 0, h - 1)\n                    x2n = torch.clamp(x2 + rx2, 0, w - 1)\n                    y2n = torch.clamp(y2 + ry2, 0, h - 1)\n                    jittered[i] = torch.stack(\n                        [torch.min(x1n, x2n), torch.min(y1n, y2n), torch.max(x1n, x2n), torch.max(y1n, y2n)]\n                    ).squeeze()\n                return jittered\n\n            def _predict_boxes_from_images(image_paths: list, target_h: int, target_w: int) -&gt; torch.Tensor:\n                \"\"\"Use BBoxPromptPredictor to predict boxes from image paths.\n                \n                Args:\n                    image_paths: List of image file paths\n                    target_h: Target image height (model input size)\n                    target_w: Target image width (model input size)\n                \n                Returns:\n                    boxes: (B, 4) tensor in pixel coords, scaled to target_h x target_w\n                \"\"\"\n                import numpy as np\n                from PIL import Image\n                \n                if self.train_bbox_predictor is None:\n                    raise ValueError(\"train_bbox_predictor is required for mode='predict'\")\n                \n                b = len(image_paths)\n                boxes = torch.zeros((b, 4), device=label.device, dtype=torch.float32)\n                \n                for i, img_path in enumerate(image_paths):\n                    if not img_path:\n                        continue\n                    try:\n                        # predict() returns bbox in original image pixels: (x1, y1, x2, y2)\n                        bbox_px = self.train_bbox_predictor.predict(img_path)\n                        if bbox_px is None:\n                            continue\n                        \n                        # Get original image size to scale bbox to target size\n                        with Image.open(img_path) as img:\n                            orig_w, orig_h = img.size\n                        \n                        # Scale bbox from original coords to target coords\n                        scale_x = target_w / orig_w\n                        scale_y = target_h / orig_h\n                        x1 = bbox_px[0] * scale_x\n                        y1 = bbox_px[1] * scale_y\n                        x2 = bbox_px[2] * scale_x\n                        y2 = bbox_px[3] * scale_y\n                        \n                        # Clamp to valid range\n                        x1 = max(0, min(x1, target_w - 1))\n                        y1 = max(0, min(y1, target_h - 1))\n                        x2 = max(0, min(x2, target_w - 1))\n                        y2 = max(0, min(y2, target_h - 1))\n                        \n                        # Ensure x1 &lt; x2 and y1 &lt; y2\n                        x1, x2 = min(x1, x2), max(x1, x2)\n                        y1, y2 = min(y1, y2), max(y1, y2)\n                        \n                        boxes[i] = torch.tensor([x1, y1, x2, y2], device=label.device, dtype=torch.float32)\n                    except Exception as e:\n                        logger.warning(f\"Failed to predict bbox for {img_path}: {e}\")\n                        continue\n                \n                return boxes\n\n            # If h, w = label.shape[-2], label.shape[-1]\n                if box_mode == \"noisy\":\n                    gt_boxes = _jitter_boxes(gt_boxes, h=h, w=w, frac=noise_frac)\n                if not (gt_boxes.sum(dim=1) == 0).all():\n                    batch[self.model.box_key] = gt_boxes.unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1,4)\n            elif box_mode == \"predict\":\n                # Get image paths from batch\n                image_path_key = self.model.image_path_key\n                image_paths = batch.get(image_path_key, [])\n                if image_paths:\n                    h, w = label.shape[-2], label.shape[-1]\n                    pred_boxes = _predict_boxes_from_images(image_paths, target_h=h, target_w=w)\n                    if not (pred_boxes.sum(dim=1) == 0).all():\n                        batch[self.model.box_key] = pred_boxes.unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1,4)\n        # prepare_targets\n        output = run_model(self.model, batch)\n        \n        # ---- Loss: fully-supervised OR semi/weak mixed ----\n        if self.training and labeled_mask is not None:\n            # Semi/weak supervision path\n            if isinstance(self.loss_func, Mask2FormerLoss):\n                # 1) 有标签子集：使用 Mask2FormerLoss\n                sup_loss = output[self.model.prefix][LOGITS].new_tensor(0.0)\n                if labeled_mask.any():\n                    # 子集化输出与标签\n                    output_labeled = {}\n                    for key, per_output in output.items():\n                        sub_out = {}\n                        for sub_k, val in                   output=output,\n                    label=label,\n                )\n\n        return output, loss\n\n    def validation_step(self, batch, batch_idx, **kwargs):\n        \"\"\"\n        Per validation step. By default, on_step=False and on_epoch=True\n        self.log(\"val_loss\", loss)\n        if isinstance(self.loss_func, Mask2FormerLoss):\n            self._compute_metric_score(\n                metric=self.validation_metric,\n                custom_metric_func=self.custom_metric_func,\n                logits=output[self.model.prefix][LOGITS],\n                label=batch[self.model.label_key],\n                semantic_masks=output[self.model.prefix][SEMANTIC_MASK],\n            )\n        else:\n            self._compute_metric_score(\n                metric=self.validation_metric,\n                custom_metric_func=self.custom_metric_func,\n                logits=output[self.model.prefix][LOGITS],\n                label=batch[self.model.label_key],\n            )\n\n        self.log(\n            self.validation_metric_name,\n            self.validation_metric,\n            on_step=False,\n            on_epoch=True,\n        )\n    \n    def training_step(self, batch, batch_idx):\n        \"\"\"\n        Per training step with GSPO enhancement.\n        \n        If GSPO is enabled and warmed up, use group-level optimization.\n        Otherwise, fall back to standard training.\n        \n        Parameters\n        ----------\n        batch\n            A dictionary containing the mini-batch data\n        batch_idx\n            Index of mini-batch\n            \n        Returns\n        -------\n        Average loss of the mini-batch data\n        \"\"\"\n        # Define forward function for GSPO\n        def forward_fn(images):\n            batch_copy = batch.copy()\n            if hasattr(self.model, 'image_key'):\n                batch_copy[self.model.image_key] = images\n            else:\n                batch_copy['image'] = images\n            output = run_model(self.model, batch_copy)\n            \n            # Extract selected experts if available\n            selected_experts = None\n            if hasattr(pred_dict, 'selected_experts'):\n                selected_experts = pred_dict['selected_experts']\n            \n            return {\"logits\": logits, \"class_logits\": class_logits}, moe_loss, selected_experts\n        \n        # non Mask2Former path\n            if isinstance(predictions, (tuple, list)) and len(predictions) &gt;= 1:\n                predictions = predictions[0]\n            return self.loss_func(input=predictions, target=targets)\n        \n        # Update Adapter quality feedback (GSPO-Adapter extension)\n            if hasattr(self.gspo_trainer, 'gspo_adapter_enabled') and self.gspo_trainer.gspo_adapter_enabled:\n                self.gspo_trainer.update_adapter_feedback(quality_scores, self.model)\n            \n            # Update LoRA on Attention quality feedback (GSPO-LoRA extension)\n            if hasattr(self.gspo_trainer, 'gspo_lora_attention_enabled') and self.gspo_trainer.gspo_lora_attention_enabled:\n                self.gspo_trainer.update_lora_attention_feedback(quality_scores, self.model)\n        \n        return loss, metrics, selected_experts_groups\n"

    "content": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport torch\nimport torchmetrics\nfrom scipy.ndimage import convolve\nfrom scipy.ndimage import distance_transform_edt as bwdist\n\n_EPS = np.spacing(1)  # the different implementation of epsilon (extreme min value) between numpy and matlab\n_TYPE = np.float64\n\n\ndef _prepare_data(pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray) -&gt; tuple:\n    \"\"\"\n    A numpy-based function for preparing &#96;&#96;pred&#96;&#96; and &#96;&#96;gt&#96;&#96;.\n    - for &#96;&#96;pred&#96;&#96;, it looks like &#96;&#96;mapminmax(im2double(...))&#96;&#96; mapminmax\n    pred = pred / 255\n    if pred.max() != pred.min():\n        pred = (pred - pred.min()) / (pred.max() - pred.min())\n    return pred, gt\n\n\ndef _get_adaptive_threshold(matrix: np.ndarray, max_value: float = 1) -&gt; float:\n    \"\"\"\n    Return an adaptive threshold, which is equal to twice the mean of &#96;&#96;matrix&#96;&#96;.\n    :param matrix: a data array\n    :param max_value: the upper limit of the threshold\n    :return: min(2 * matrix.mean(), max_value)\n    \"\"\"\n    return min(2 * matrix.mean(), max_value)\n\n\nclass Fmeasure(object):\n    def __init__(self, beta: float = 1.0):\n        \"\"\"\n        F-measure for SOD.\n        ::\n            @inproceedings{Fmeasure,\n                title={Frequency-tuned salient region detection},\n                author={Achanta, Radhakrishna and Hemami, Sheila and Estrada, Francisco and S{\\\"u}sstrunk, Sabine},\n                booktitle=CVPR,\n                number={CONF},\n                pages={1597--1604},\n                year={2009}\n            }\n        :param beta: the weight of the precision\n        \"\"\"\n        self.beta = beta\n        self.precisions = []\n        self.recalls = []\n        self.adaptive_fms = []\n        self.changeable_fms = []\n\n    def step(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray):\n        pred, gt = _prepare_data(pred, gt)\n\n        adaptive_fm = self.cal_adaptive_fm(pred=pred, gt=gt)\n        self.adaptive_fms.append(adaptive_fm)\n\n        precisions, recalls, changeable_fms = self.cal_pr(pred=pred, gt=gt)\n        self.precisions.append(precisions)\n        self.recalls.append(recalls)\n        self.changeable_fms.append(changeable_fms)\n\n    def cal_adaptive_fm(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray) -&gt; float:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the adaptive F-measure.\n        :return: adaptive_fm\n        \"\"\"\n        # &#96;&#96;np.count_nonzero&#96;&#96; is faster and better\n        adaptive_threshold = _get_adaptive_threshold(pred, max_value=1)\n        binary_predcition = pred &gt;= adaptive_threshold\n        area_intersection = binary_predcition[gt].sum()\n        if area_intersection == 0:\n            adaptive_fm = 0\n        else:\n            pre = area_intersection / np.count_nonzero(binary_predcition)\n            rec = area_intersection / np.count_nonzero(gt)\n            adaptive_fm = (1 + self.beta) * pre * rec / (self.beta * pre + rec)\n        return adaptive_fm\n\n    def cal_pr(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray) -&gt; tuple:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the corresponding precision and recall when the threshold changes from 0 to 255.\n        These precisions and recalls can be used to obtain the mean F-measure, maximum F-measure,\n        precision-recall curve and F-measure-threshold curve.\n        For convenience, &#96;&#96;changeable_fms&#96;&#96; is provided here, which can be used directly to obtain\n        the mean F-measure, maximum F-measure and F-measure-threshold curve.\n        :return: precisions, recalls, changeable_fms\n        \"\"\"\n        pred = (pred * 255).astype(np.uint8)\n        bins = np.linspace(0, 256, 257)\n        fg_hist, _ = np.histogram(pred[gt], bins=bins)\n        bg_hist, _ = np.histogram(pred[~gt], bins=bins)\n\n        fg_w_thrs = np.cumsum(np.flip(fg_hist), axis=0)\n        bg_w_thrs = np.cumsum(np.flip(bg_hist), axis=0)\n\n        TPs = fg_w_thrs\n        Ps = fg_w_thrs + bg_w_thrs\n\n        Ps[Ps == 0] = 1\n        T = max(np.count_nonzero(gt), 1)\n\n        precisions = TPs / Ps\n        recalls = TPs / T\n\n        numerator = (1 + self.beta) * precisions * recalls\n        denominator = np.where(numerator == 0, 1, self.beta * precisions + recalls)\n        changeable_fms = numerator / denominator\n        return precisions, recalls, changeable_fms\n\n    def get_results(self) -&gt; dict:\n        \"\"\"\n        Return the results about F-measure.\n        :return: dict(fm=dict(adp=adaptive_fm, curve=changeable_fm), pr=dict(p=precision, r=recall))\n        \"\"\"\n        adaptive_fm = np.mean(np.array(self.adaptive_fms, _TYPE))\n        changeable_fm = np.mean(np.array(self.changeable_fms, dtype=_TYPE), axis=0)\n        precision = np.mean(np.array(self.precisions, dtype=_TYPE), axis=0)  # N, 256\n        recall = np.mean(np.array(self.recalls, dtype=_TYPE), axis=0)  # N, 256\n        return dict(fm=dict(adp=adaptive_fm, curve=changeable_fm), pr=dict(p=precision, r=recall))\n\n\nclass MAE_SOD(object):\n    def __init__(self):\n        \"\"\"\n        MAE(mean absolute error) for SOD.\n        ::\n            @inproceedings{MAE,\n                title={Saliency filters: Contrast based filtering for salient region detection},\n                author={Perazzi, Federico and Kr{\\\"a}henb{\\\"u}hl, Philipp and Pritch, Yael and Hornung, Alexander},\n   pred, gt = _prepare_data(pred, gt)\n\n        mae = self.cal_mae(pred, gt)\n        # mae = np.sum(cv2.absdiff(gt.astype(float), pred.astype(float))) / (pred.shape[1] * pred.shape[0])\n        self.maes.append(mae)\n\n    def cal_mae(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray) -&gt; np.ndarray:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the mean absolute error.\n        :return: mae\n        \"\"\"\n        mae = np.mean(np.abs(pred - gt))\n        return mae\n\n    def get_results(self) -&gt; dict:\n        \"\"\"\n        Return the results about MAE.\n        :return: dict(mae=mae)\n        \"\"\"\n        mae = np.mean(np.array(self.maes, _TYPE))\n        return dict(mae=mae)\n\n\nclass Smeasure(object):\n    def __init__(self, alpha: float = 0.5):\n        \"\"\"\n        S-measure(Structure-measure) of SOD.\n        ::\n            @inproceedings{Smeasure,\n                title={Structure-measure: A new way to eval foreground maps},\n                author={Fan, Deng-Ping and Cheng, Ming-Ming and Liu, Yun and Li, Tao and Borji, Ali},\n                booktitle=ICCV,\n                pages={4548--4557},\n                year={2017}\n            }\n        :param alpha: the weight for balancing the object score and the region score\n        \"\"\"\n        self.sms = []\n        self.alpha = alpha\n\n    def step(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray):\n        pred, gt = _prepare_data(pred=pred, gt=gt)\n\n        sm = self.cal_sm(pred, gt)\n        self.sms.append(sm)\n\n    def cal_sm(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray) -&gt; float:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the S-measure.\n        :return: s-measure\n        \"\"\"\n        y = np.mean(gt)\n        if y == 0:\n            sm = 1 - np.mean(pred)\n        elif y == 1:\n            sm = np.mean(pred)\n        else:\n            sm = self.alpha * self.object(pred, gt) + (1 - self.alpha) * self.region(pred, gt)\n            sm = max(0, sm)\n        return sm\n\n    def object(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray) -&gt; float:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the object score.\n        \"\"\"\n        fg = pred * gt\n        bg = (1 - pred) * (1 - gt)\n        u = np.mean(gt)\n        object_score = u * self.s_object(fg, gt) + (1 - u) * self.s_object(bg, 1 - gt)\n        return object_score\n\n    def s_object(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray) -&gt; float:\n        x = np.mean(pred[gt == 1])\n        sigma_x = np.std(pred[gt == 1], ddof=1)\n        score = 2 * x / (np.power(x, 2) + 1 + sigma_x + _EPS)\n        return score\n\n    def region(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray) -&gt; float:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the region score.\n        \"\"\"\n        x, y = self.centroid(gt)\n        part_info = self.divide_with_xy(pred, gt, x, y)\n        w1, w2, w3, w4 = part_info[\"weight\"]\n        # assert np.isclose(w1 + w2 + w3 + w4, 1), (w1 + w2 + w3 + w4, pred.mean(), gt.mean())\n\n        pred1, pred2, pred3, pred4 = part_info[\"pred\"]\n        gt1, gt2, gt3, gt4 = part_info[\"gt\"]\n        score1 = self.ssim(pred1, gt1)\n        score2 = self.ssim(pred2, gt2)\n        score3 = self.ssim(pred3, gt3)\n        score4 = self.ssim(pred4, gt4)\n\n        return w1 * score1 + w2 * score2 + w3 * score3 + w4 * score4\n\n    def centroid(self, matrix: np.ndarray) -&gt; tuple:\n        \"\"\"\n        To ensure consistency with the matlab code, one is added to the centroid coordinate,\n        so there is no need to use the redundant addition operation when dividing the region later,\n        because the sequence generated by &#96;&#96;1:X&#96;&#96; in matlab will contain &#96;&#96;X&#96;&#96;.\n        :param matrix: a bool data array\n        :return: the centroid coordinate\n        \"\"\"\n        h, w = matrix.shape\n        area_object = np.count_nonzero(matrix)\n        if area_object == 0:\n            x = np.round(w / 2)\n            y = np.round(h / 2)\n        else:\n            # More details can be found at: https://www.yuque.com/lart/blog/gpbigm\n            y, x = np.argwhere(matrix).mean(axis=0).round()\n        return int(x) + 1, int(y) + 1\n\n    def divide_with_xy(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray, x: int, y: int) -&gt; dict:\n        \"\"\"\n        Use (x,y) to divide the &#96;&#96;pred&#96;&#96; and the &#96;&#96;gt&#96;&#96; into four submatrices, respectively.\n        \"\"\"\n        h, w = gt.shape\n        area = h * w\n\n        gt_LT = gt[0:y, 0:x]\n        gt_RT = gt[0:y, x:w]\n        gt_LB = gt[y:h, 0:x]\n        gt_RB = gt[y:h, x:w]\n\n        pred_LT = pred[0:y, 0:x]\n        pred_RT = pred[0:y, x:w]\n        pred_LB = pred[y:h, 0:x]\n        pred_RB = pred[y:h, x:w]\n\n        w1 = x * y / area\n        w2 = y * (w - x) / area\n        w3 = (h - y) * x / area\n        w4 = 1 - w1 - w2 - w3\n\n        return dict(\n            gt=(gt_LT, gt_RT, gt_LB, gt_RB),\n            pred=(pred_LT, pred_RT, pred_LB, pred_RB),\n            weight=(w1, w2, w3, w4),\n        )\n\n    def ssim(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray) -&gt; float:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the ssim score.\n        \"\"\"\n        h, w = pred.shape\n        N = h * w\n\n        x = np.mean(pred)\n        y = np.mean(gt)\n\n        sigma_x = np.sum((pred - x) ** 2) / (N - 1)\n        sigma_y = np.sum((gt - y) ** 2) / (N - 1)\n        sigma_xy = np.sum((pred - x) * (gt - y)) / (N - 1)\n\n        alpha = 4 * x * y * sigma_xy\n        beta = (x**2 + y**2) * (sigma_x + sigma_y)\n\n        if alpha != 0:\n            score = alpha / (beta + _EPS)\n        elif alpha == 0 and beta == 0:\n            score = 1\n        else:\n            score = 0\n        return score\n\n    def get_results(self) -&gt; dict:\n        \"\"\"\n        Return the results about S-measure.\n        :return: dict(sm=sm)\n        \"\"\"\n        sm = np.mean(np.array(self.sms, dtype=_TYPE))\n        return dict(sm=sm)\n\n\nclass Emeasure(object):\n    def __init__(self):\n        \"\"\"\n        E-measure(Enhanced-alignment Measure) for SOD.\n        More details about the implementation can be found in https://www.yuque.com/lart/blog/lwgt38\n        ::\n            @inproceedings{Emeasure,\n                title=\"Enhanced-alignment Measure for Binary Foreground Map Evaluation\",\n                author=\"Deng-Ping {Fan} and Cheng {Gong} and Yang {Cao} and Bo {Ren} and Ming-Ming {Cheng} and Ali {Borji}\",\n                booktitle=IJCAI,\n                pages=\"698--704\",\n                year={2018}\n            }\n        \"\"\"\n        self.adaptive_ems = []\n        self.changeable_ems = []\n\n    def step(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray):\n        pred, gt = _prepare_data(pred=pred, gt=gt)\n\n        self.gt_fg_numel = np.count_nonzero(gt)\n        self.gt_size = gt.shape[0] * gt.shape[1]\n\n        changeable_ems = self.cal_changeable_em(pred, gt)\n        self.changeable_ems.append(changeable_ems)\n        adaptive_em = self.cal_adaptive_em(pred, gt)\n        self.adaptive_ems.append(adaptive_em)\n\n    def cal_adaptive_em(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray) -&gt; float:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the adaptive E-measure.\n        :return: adaptive_em\n        \"\"\"\n        adaptive_threshold = _get_adaptive_threshold(pred, max_value=1)\n        adaptive_em = self.cal_em_with_threshold(pred, gt, threshold=adaptive_threshold)\n        return adaptive_em\n\n    def cal_changeable_em(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray) -&gt; np.ndarray:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the changeable E-measure, which can be used to obtain the mean E-measure,\n        the maximum E-measure and the E-measure-threshold curve.\n        :return: changeable_ems\n        \"\"\"\n        changeable_ems = self.cal_em_with_cumsumhistogram(pred, gt)\n        return changeable_ems\n\n    def cal_em_with_threshold(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray, threshold: float) -&gt; float:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the E-measure corresponding to the specific threshold.\n        Variable naming rules within the function:\n        &#96;&#96;[pred attribute(foreground fg, background bg)]_[gt attribute(foreground fg, background bg)]_[meaning]&#96;&#96;\n        If only &#96;&#96;pred&#96;&#96; or &#96;&#96;gt&#96;&#96; is considered, another corresponding attribute location is replaced with '&#96;&#96;_&#96;&#96;'.\n        \"\"\"\n        binarized_pred = pred &gt;= threshold\n        fg_fg_numel = np.count_nonzero(binarized_pred &amp; gt)\n        fg_bg_numel = np.count_nonzero(binarized_pred &amp; ~gt)\n\n        fg___numel = fg_fg_numel + fg_bg_numel\n        bg___numel = self.gt_size - fg___numel\n\n        if self.gt_fg_numel == 0:\n            enhanced_matrix_sum = bg___numel\n        elif self.gt_fg_numel == self.gt_size:\n            enhanced_matrix_sum = fg___numel\n        else:\n            parts_numel, combinations = self.generate_parts_numel_combinations(\n                fg_fg_numel=fg_fg_numel,\n                fg_bg_numel=fg_bg_numel,\n                pred_fg_numel=fg___numel,\n                pred_bg_numel=bg___numel,\n            )\n\n            results_parts = []\n            for i, (part_numel, combination) in enumerate(zip(parts_numel, combinations)):\n                align_matrix_value = (\n                    2 * (combination[0] * combination[1]) / (combination[0] ** 2 + combination[1] ** 2 + _EPS)\n                )\n                enhanced_matrix_value = (align_matrix_value + 1) ** 2 / 4\n                results_parts.append(enhanced_matrix_value * part_numel)\n            enhanced_matrix_sum = sum(results_parts)\n\n        em = enhanced_matrix_sum / (self.gt_size - 1 + _EPS)\n        return em\n\n    def cal_em_with_cumsumhistogram(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray) -&gt; np.ndarray:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the E-measure corresponding to the threshold that varies from 0 to 255..\n        Variable naming rules within the function:\n        &#96;&#96;[pred attribute(foreground fg, background bg)]_[gt attribute(foreground fg, background bg)]_[meaning]&#96;&#96;\n        If only &#96;&#96;pred&#96;&#96; or &#96;&#96;gt&#96;&#96; is considered, another corresponding attribute location is replaced with '&#96;&#96;_&#96;&#96;'.\n        \"\"\"\n        pred = (pred * 255).astype(np.uint8)\n        bins = np.linspace(0, 256, 257)\n        fg_fg_hist, _ = np.histogram(pred[gt], bins=bins)\n        fg_bg_hist, _ = np.histogram(pred[~gt], bins=bins)\n        fg_fg_numel_w_thrs = np.cumsum(np.flip(fg_fg_hist), axis=0)\n        fg_bg_numel_w_thrs = np.cumsum(np.flip(fg_bg_hist), axis=0)\n\n        fg___numel_w_thrs = fg_fg_numel_w_thrs + fg_bg_numel_w_thrs\n        bg___numel_w_thrs = self.gt_size - fg___numel_w_thrs\n\n        if self.gt_fg_numel == 0:\n            enhanced_matrix_sum = bg___numel_w_thrs\n        elif self.gt_fg_numel == self.gt_size:\n            enhanced_matrix_sum = fg___numel_w_thrs\n        else:\n            parts_numel_w_thrs, combinations = self.generate_parts_numel_combinations(\n                fg_fg_numel=fg_fg_numel_w_thrs,\n                fg_bg_numel=fg_bg_numel_w_thrs,\n                pred_fg_numel=fg___numel_w_thrs,\n                pred_bg_numel=bg___numel_w_thrs,\n            )\n\n            results_parts = np.empty(shape=(4, 256), dtype=np.float64)\n            for i, (part_numel, combination) in enumerate(zip(parts_numel_w_thrs, combinations)):\n                align_matrix_value = (\n                    2 * (combination[0] * combination[1]) / (combination[0] ** 2 + combination[1] ** 2 + _EPS)\n                )\n                enhanced_matrix_value = (align_matrix_value + 1) ** 2 / 4\n                results_parts[i] = enhanced_matrix_value * part_numel\n            enhanced_matrix_sum = results_parts.sum(axis=0)\n\n        em = enhanced_matrix_sum / (self.gt_size - 1 + _EPS)\n        return em\n\n    def generate_parts_numel_combinations(self, fg_fg_numel, fg_bg_numel, pred_fg_numel, pred_bg_numel):\n        bg_fg_numel = self.gt_fg_numel - fg_fg_numel\n        bg_bg_numel = pred_bg_numel - bg_fg_numel\n\n        parts_numel = [fg_fg_numel, fg_bg_numel, bg_fg_numel, bg_bg_numel]\n\n        mean_pred_value = pred_fg_numel / self.gt_size\n        mean_gt_value = self.gt_fg_numel / self.gt_size\n\n        demeaned_pred_fg_value = 1 - mean_pred_value\n        demeaned_pred_bg_value = 0 - mean_pred_value\n        demeaned_gt_fg_value = 1 - mean_gt_value\n        demeaned_gt_bg_value = 0 - mean_gt_value\n\n        combinations = [\n            (demeaned_pred_fg_value, demeaned_gt_fg_value),\n            (demeaned_pred_fg_value, demeaned_gt_bg_value),\n            (demeaned_pred_bg_value, demeaned_gt_fg_value),\n            (demeaned_pred_bg_value, demeaned_gt_bg_value),\n        ]\n        return parts_numel, combinations\n\n    def get_results(self) -&gt; dict:\n        \"\"\"\n        Return the results about E-measure.\n        :return: dict(em=dict(adp=adaptive_em, curve=changeable_em))\n        \"\"\"\n        adaptive_em = np.mean(np.array(self.adaptive_ems, dtype=_TYPE))\n        changeable_em = np.mean(np.array(self.changeable_ems, dtype=_TYPE), axis=0)\n        return dict(em=dict(adp=adaptive_em, curve=changeable_em))\n\n\nclass WeightedFmeasure(object):\n    def __init__(self, beta: float = 0.3):\n        \"\"\"\n        Weighted F-measure for SOD.\n        ::\n            @inproceedings{wFmeasure,\n                title={How to eval foreground maps?},\n                author={Margolin, Ran and Zelnik-Manor, Lihi and Tal, Ayellet},\n                booktitle=CVPR,\n                pages={248--255},\n                year={2014}\n            }\n        :param beta: the weight of the precision\n        \"\"\"\n        self.beta = beta\n        self.weighted_fms = []\n\n    def step(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray):\n        pred, gt = _prepare_data(pred=pred, gt=gt)\n\n        if np.all(~gt):\n            wfm = 0\n        else:\n            wfm = self.cal_wfm(pred, gt)\n        self.weighted_fms.append(wfm)\n\n    def cal_wfm(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray) -&gt; float:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the weighted F-measure.\n        \"\"\"\n        # [Dst,IDXT] = bwdist(dGT);\n        Dst, Idxt = bwdist(gt == 0, return_indices=True)\n\n        # %Pixel dependency\n        # E = abs(FG-dGT);\n        E = np.abs(pred - gt)\n        # Et = E;\n        # Et(~GT)=Et(IDXT(~GT)); %To deal correctly with the edges of the foreground region\n        Et = np.copy(E)\n        Et[gt == 0] = Et[Idxt[0][gt == 0], Idxt[1][gt == 0]]\n\n        # K = fspecial('gaussian',7,5);\n        # EA = imfilter(Et,K);\n        K = self.matlab_style_gauss2D((7, 7), sigma=5)\n        EA = convolve(Et, weights=K, mode=\"constant\", cval=0)\n        # MIN_E_EA = E;\n        # MIN_E_EA(GT &amp; EA&lt;E) = EA(GT &amp; EA&lt;E);\n        MIN_E_EA = np.where(gt &amp; (EA &lt; E), EA, E)\n\n        # %Pixel importance\n        # B = ones(size(GT));\n        # B(~GT) = 2-1*exp(log(1-0.5)/5.*Dst(~GT));\n        # Ew = MIN_E_EA.*B;\n        B = np.where(gt == 0, 2 - np.exp(np.log(0.5) / 5 * Dst), np.ones_like(gt))\n        Ew = MIN_E_EA * B\n\n        # TPw = sum(dGT(:)) - sum(sum(Ew(GT)));\n        # FPw = sum(sum(Ew(~GT)));\n        TPw = np.sum(gt) - np.sum(Ew[gt == 1])\n        FPw = np.sum(Ew[gt == 0])\n\n        # R = 1- mean2(Ew(GT)); %Weighed Recall\n        # P = TPw./(eps+TPw+FPw); %Weighted Precision\n        # 注意这里使用mask索引矩阵的时候不可使用Ew[gt]，这实际上仅在索引Ew的0维度\n        R = 1 - np.mean(Ew[gt == 1])\n        P = TPw / (TPw + FPw + _EPS)\n\n        # % Q = (1+Beta^2)*(R*P)./(eps+R+(Beta.*P));\n        Q = (1 + self.beta) * R * P / (R + self.beta * P + _EPS)\n\n        return Q\n\n    def matlab_style_gauss2D(self, shape: tuple = (7, 7), sigma: int = 5) -&gt; np.ndarray:\n        \"\"\"\n        2D gaussian mask - should give the same result as MATLAB's\n        fspecial('gaussian',[shape],[sigma])\n        \"\"\"\n        m, n = [(ss - 1) / 2 for ss in shape]\n        y, x = np.ogrid[-m : m + 1, -n : n + 1]\n        h = np.exp(-(x * x + y * y) / (2 * sigma * sigma))\n        h[h &lt; np.finfo(h.dtype).eps * h.max()] = 0\n        sumh = h.sum()\n        if sumh != 0:\n            h /= sumh\n        return h\n\n    def get_results(self) -&gt; dict:\n        \"\"\"\n        Return the results about weighted F-measure.\n        :return: dict(wfm=weighted_fm)\n        \"\"\"\n        weighted_fm = np.mean(np.array(self.weighted_fms, dtype=_TYPE))\n        return dict(wfm=weighted_fm)\n\n\nclass Multiclass_IoU(torchmetrics.Metric):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute the IoU for multi-class semantic segmentation based on https://github.com/xieenze/Trans2Seg/blob/master/segmentron/utils/score.py.\n    The direct use of torchmetrics for large dataset will lead to issues such as high CPU usage or insufficient memory.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, num_classes):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.add_state(\"total_inter\", default=torch.zeros(num_classes), dist_reduce_fx=None)\n        self.add_state(\"total_union\", default=torch.zeros(num_classes), dist_reduce_fx=None)\n        self.num_classes = num_classes\n\n    def update(self, logits, labels):\n        inter, union = self.batch_intersection_union(logits, labels)\n        self.total_inter += inter\n        self.total_union += union\n\n    def compute(self):\n        IoU = 1.0 * self.total_inter / (2.220446049250313e-16 + self.total_union)\n        return torch.tensor(IoU.mean().item())\n\n    def batch_intersection_union(self, output, target):\n        mini = 1\n        maxi = self.num_classes\n        nbins = self.num_classes\n        # output: [B, C, H, W] (logits or probabilities)\n        # target: [B, H, W] with background==0, foreground classes in [1..C-1]\n        tgt = target.float()\n        fg_mask = (tgt &gt; 0).float()  # ignore background pixels\n\n        predict = torch.argmax(output, 1).float()  # [B,H,W] in [0..C-1]\n        # shift to [1..C] so that 0 can be used as \"ignored\" for histc\n        predict = (predict + 1.0) * fg_mask\n        tgt = (tgt + 1.0) * fg_mask\n\n        intersection = predict * (predict == tgt).float()\n        # areas of intersection and union\n        area_inter = torch.histc(intersection, bins=nbins, min=mini, max=maxi)\n        area_pred = torch.histc(predict, bins=nbins, min=mini, max=maxi)\n        area_lab = torch.histc(tgt, bins=nbins, min=mini, max=maxi)\n        area_union = area_pred + area_lab - area_inter\n        assert torch.sum(area_inter &gt; area_union).item() == 0, \"Intersection area should be smaller than Union area\"\n        return area_inter.float(), area_union.float()\n\n\nclass Binary_IoU(torchmetrics.Metric):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute the IoU for binary semantic segmentation. The direct use of torchmetrics to calculate IoU for multiple samples does not yield accurate results.\n    So we iteratively calculate metric values and then take the average.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n    ):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.add_state(\"logits\", default=[], dist_reduce_fx=None)\n        self.add_state(\"labels\", default=[], dist_reduce_fx=None)\n\n    def update(self, logits, labels):\n        self.logits.append(logits)\n        self.labels.append(labels)\n\n    def compute(self):\n        # Handle different image sizes by processing individually instead of concatenating\n        res_list = []\n        metric = torchmetrics.JaccardIndex(task=\"binary\")\n        for logit, label in zip(self.logits, self.labels):\n            # Move to CPU and remove batch dim if present\n            logit = logit.cpu()\n            label = label.cpu()\n            if logit.dim() == 3 and logit.shape[0] == 1:\n                logit = logit.squeeze(0)\n            if label.dim() == 3 and label.shape[0] == 1:\n                label = label.squeeze(0)\n            res_list.append(metric(logit, label))\n        return torch.mean(torch.tensor(res_list))\n\n\nclass Binary_DICE(torchmetrics.Metric):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute the DICE coefficient for binary semantic segmentation.\n    DICE = 2 * |intersection| / (|pred| + |gt|) = 2 * IoU / (1 + IoU)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n    ):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.add_state(\"logits\", default=[], dist_reduce_fx=None)\n        self.add_state(\"labels\", default=[], dist_reduce_fx=None)\n\n    def update(self, logits, labels):\n        self.logits.append(logits)\n        self.labels.append(labels)\n\n    def compute(self):\n        # Handle different image sizes by processing individually instead of concatenating\n        res_list = []\n        # Compute DICE from IoU: DICE = 2 * IoU / (1 + IoU)\n        iou_metric = torchmetrics.JaccardIndex(task=\"binary\")\n        for logit, label in zip(self.logits, self.labels):\n            # Move to CPU and remove batch dim if present\n            logit = logit.cpu()\n            label = label.cpu()\n            if logit.dim() == 3 and logit.shape[0] == 1:\n                logit = logit.squeeze(0)\n            if label.dim() == 3 and label.shape[0] == 1:\n                label = label.squeeze(0)\n            iou = iou_metric(logit, label)\n            dice = 2 * iou / (1 + iou)\n            res_list.append(dice)\n        return torch.mean(torch.tensor(res_list))\n\n\nclass Multiclass_DICE(torchmetrics.Metric):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute the DICE coefficient for multi-class semantic segmentation.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, num_classes):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.add_state(\"total_inter\", default=torch.zeros(num_classes), dist_reduce_fx=None)\n        self.add_state(\"total_union\", default=torch.zeros(num_classes), dist_reduce_fx=None)\n        self.num_classes = num_classes\n\n    def update(self, logits, labels):\n        inter, union = self.batch_intersection_union(logits, labels)\n        self.total_inter += inter\n        self.total_union += union\n\n    def compute(self):\n        # DICE = 2 * intersection / (pred + gt)\n        # We can compute from IoU: DICE = 2 * IoU / (1 + IoU)\n        IoU = 1.0 * self.total_inter / (2.220446049250313e-16 + self.total_union)\n        DICE = 2.0 * IoU / (1.0 + IoU)\n        return torch.tensor(DICE.mean().item())\n\n    def batch_intersection_union(self, output, target):\n        mini = 1\n        maxi = self.num_classes\n        nbins = self.num_classes\n        tgt = target.float()\n        fg_mask = (tgt &gt; 0).float()  # ignore background pixels\n\n        predict = torch.argmax(output, 1).float()\n        predict = (predict + 1.0) * fg_mask\n        tgt = (tgt + 1.0) * fg_mask\n\n        intersection =
